en.title: 🏛️ JAIPUR - The PINK CITY!
en.mainText: Imagine a whole city painted PINK! That's Jaipur! A king painted it pink in 1876 to welcome visitors.

keyFacts.text: Built in 1727 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II
~45 Lakh people live here
Why PINK? Because pink = WELCOME! 🎨
Hawa Mahal has 953 tiny windows! 🪟
City Palace is still a real palace - the king's family LIVES there! 👑
Jantar Mantar = Giant stone telescope 🔭
Street food: Mirchi Pakora, Ker Sangri, Fafda Jalebi 🍜
Best time to visit: October-March 🌤️

coolFacts.text: The pink color was chosen because pink represents HOSPITALITY and WELCOME! 🎨
Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds) was built so the queen could watch street festivals without being seen! 👑
Jaipur is an early planned Indian city, founded in 1727 and laid out in a grid pattern. 🏗️
The streets are designed in a planned grid pattern - super organized! 📐
City Palace blends Mughal and European architecture - it's a FUSION! 🏰
Jantar Mantar is an ancient astronomy observation tool made of STONE! 🔭

didYouKnow.text: Jaipur gets its nickname 'The Pink City' because Many buildings in Jaipur's historic walled city follow a pink-and-terracotta colour tradition that dates back to the 19th century. 🌸

tryThis.text: Next time you see something pink - a flower, a balloon, or even pink lemonade - think of Jaipur and imagine walking through the famous Pink City! 💕

en.narration:
Jaipur is the PINK CITY! Imagine walking down a street where many buildings and landmarks in the old city are associated with Jaipur's pink colour tradition! 🌸

Long, long ago, a clever king wanted visitors to feel super welcome, so he painted the WHOLE city pink - the color of love! 💕

The Hawa Mahal is the most famous building - it has 953 TINY windows! Why so many? A queen wanted to watch street parties without anyone seeing her. So the king built this magic screen - she could look OUT, but people couldn't see IN! Genius! 💡

If you visit Jaipur, wear your brightest pink clothes and take the coolest photos! The City Palace is STILL where the king's family lives! And the Jantar Mantar is like the one of the oldest telescope made of stone! 🔭

Jaipur street food is AMAZING - try Mirchi Pakora (fried spicy peppers) and Fafda Jalebi (sweet and crispy)! 🍜

hi.title: 🏛️ जयपुर - गुलाबी शहर!
hi.mainText: कल्पना करो, एक पूरा शहर गुलाबी रंग में रंगा हुआ! वह जयपुर है!

en.title: 🗣️ HINDI - Let's Learn!
en.mainText: Hindi is widely spoken in Rajasthan and is written in the Devanagari script.

keyFacts.text: RAJASTHAN = RAJ (King) + STHAN (Place) = LAND OF KINGS! 👑
NAMASTE = Hello/Goodbye 🙏
SHUKRIYA = Thank you 💚
HAWA = Wind (Hawa Mahal = Palace of Winds!) 💨
DAL BAATI = Lentils + Bread 🍲
THAR = Desert 🏜️
UNT = Camel 🐪
Hindi is spoken by hundreds of millions of people, and it is one of India's major languages. 🌍
Devanagari script = Beautiful connected mountains! ⛰️
Tongue twister: 'Rajasthan mein camel chale, Thar desert mein camel gale!' 😄

coolFacts.text: Hindi uses Devanagari script - looks like little mountains connected together! ⛰️
Hindi is spoken by hundreds of millions of people in India and around the world. 🌍
Devanagari has 45 basic letters - each one looks like a tiny picture! 📸
Hindi is an official language of the Union for official purposes under Article 343 of the Constitution; India does not have a single official language of the Union for official purposes. 🇮🇳
You can write Hindi from left to right (like English) but it reads like a continuous line! 📝
Hindi borrowed words from Urdu, Arabic, Persian, English, and Sanskrit! It's a language soup! 🍲
No capital letters in Hindi - all letters are the same size! EQUAL and FAIR! ✨
Many Bollywood songs are in Hindi - have you heard them? 🎵

didYouKnow.text: The word 'Rajasthan' literally means 'Land of Kings' in Hindi! RAJ = King, STHAN = Place/Land! Every time you say Rajasthan, you're saying a Hindi sentence! 👑

tryThis.text: Learn 5 Hindi words and teach your friends! NAMASTE (hello), SHUKRIYA (thank you), KHANA (food), PANI (water), and HAWA (wind). Practice saying them - it's SO much fun! 🎤

en.narration:
Hindi is widely spoken in India and is written in the Devanagari script. The word 'Rajasthan' means LAND OF KINGS - RAJ means King, and STHAN means Place! 👑

When you say Rajasthan, you're saying you're in the King's Land!

Hindi letters look like little connected mountains - SO PRETTY! देवनागरी - Look at these curvy letters!

Over hundreds of millions people speak Hindi all around the world! That's like... everyone in a HUGE city that stretches across 10 countries! 🌍

Here are cool words to say:
- NAMASTE (Nah-muh-STAY) = Hello!
- SHUKRIYA (SHOO-kree-yah) = Thank you!
- UNT (OON-T) = Camel!

Try saying them 3 times fast - it's fun! 😄

hi.title: 🗣️ हिंदी - आइए सीखें!
hi.mainText: राजस्थान में हिंदी व्यापक रूप से बोली जाती है और इसे देवनागरी लिपि में लिखा जाता है।

en.title: 🍲 DAL BAATI - The YUMMIEST FOOD!
en.mainText: DAL = Soft beans with spices. BAATI = Round bread baked with LOTS of butter (ghee). Together = SUPER DELICIOUS! 🤤

keyFacts.text: 3 parts: DAL (lentils), BAATI (bread), CHURMA (sweet crumble) 🍽️
Takes 45 minutes to make
Farmers ate it because it gave them ENERGY to work all day! 💪
Even KINGS ate it at festivals! 👑
Every family has their OWN special recipe
Why it's good: Protein + Carbs + Fat = useful source of energy! ⚡
Variations: Spicy, mild, or sweet versions!
Try it in: Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur dhabas 🍜
Best with: Thick yogurt (lassi) 🥛
Calories: ~400 per serving (perfect for active kids!) 💪

coolFacts.text: Dal Baati was warrior food! Soldiers ate it before battles for ENERGY! ⚔️
The 'churma' topping is made by crushing baati with ghee and sugar - it's like bread pudding! 🍮
Some families add dried fruits like dates and raisins to make it sweet! 🍯
Dal Baati tastes best when eaten with pickles and yogurt (lassi)! 🥒
There are regional variations - Jodhpuri Dal Baati tastes different from Udaipuri! 🏰
You can make Dal Baati in 45 minutes - perfect for weekend cooking! ⏰
It's PROTEIN-PACKED - useful source of energy for sports and activities! 💪
Every restaurant in Rajasthan has its own secret recipe! 🤐

didYouKnow.text: Dal Baati is SO popular that there's a tongue twister in Hindi: 'Dal Baati, Churma, Ker Sangri' - it's the traditional Rajasthani meal combo! Even kids chant it like a rhyme! 🎵

tryThis.text: Ask your parents to make Dal Baati at home and help them cook! Mix the dough, help shape the baati, and crush the churma. Then taste it fresh and hot - NOTHING tastes better than food you cooked yourself! 🍳

en.narration:
Dal Baati is the well-known food from Rajasthan! 🍲

Long, long ago, shepherds and farmers ate it because it had SO MUCH ENERGY! It's like... superhero food! 💪

The 'dal' is soft beans cooked with yummy spices - warm, comforting, and SO tasty!

The 'baati' is bread baked in an oven - crunchy outside, fluffy inside!

And when you crush the baati and mix it with butter and sugar... WOW! It becomes 'churma' - absolutely delicious! 🤤

Every family in Rajasthan makes it their OWN way - some add dried fruit, some make it spicy, some make it sweet!

It takes only 45 minutes to make - you can help your parents cook it!

Did you know? This food is so good that even kings ate it during special festivals and celebrations! 👑

You HAVE to try it! Your taste buds will do a happy dance! 🎉

hi.title: 🍲 दाल बाटी - सबसे स्वादिष्ट खाना!
hi.mainText: दाल = मसालों के साथ नरम दालें। बाटी = घी के साथ पकाई गई गोल रोटी

en.title: 🏰 HAWA MAHAL - Palace of Winds!
en.mainText: The WEIRDEST, COOLEST building ever! It looks like a giant pink screen with 953 TINY windows! 🪟

keyFacts.text: Built in 1799 (200+ years old!) 📅
Made of pink sandstone ✨
Only 43cm THICK at the back! (Like 3 school notebooks!) 📚
953 TINY windows - try counting them! 🪟
Why so many windows? A queen wanted to watch street parties without being seen! 👑
NO stairs inside - it's just a beautiful FRONT! 🎪
5 stories tall 🏢
Best photo time: Sunrise = GOLDEN LIGHT! 🌅
Sunset = PINK ON PINK = MAGICAL! 🌄
Take 30 minutes to explore 🚶
Nearby: City Palace, Jantar Mantar, Bapu Bazaar 🛍️

coolFacts.text: Hawa Mahal is so THIN - only 43cm! - that it's basically a wall, not a real building! 📏
The windows are SO SMALL that you can barely fit your hand through them! 👋
It took workers 2 years to build all 953 windows by HAND! 🔨
The pink color comes from local pink sandstone quarries! 🪨
Inside, there are narrow passages connecting the windows - like a secret maze! 🌀
Sunrise photography: The light turns the building GOLD! 📸
Sunset photography: Pink building + pink sky = DREAM SCENE! 🌅
The royal family used it like a VIP booth at a sports stadium - watching, not being seen! 👑

didYouKnow.text: Hawa Mahal means 'Palace of Winds' - and it actually has windows on BOTH sides so cool breezes flow through the entire building! That's why women inside felt comfortable even in hot weather! 💨

tryThis.text: If you visit Jaipur, take a photo through one of the tiny windows! Can you see the street through it? Or visit at sunrise and watch the building turn from pink to golden - it's like magic happening in real-time! ✨

en.narration:
Hawa Mahal means PALACE OF WINDS! 💨

This building has 953 TINY windows - can you imagine? That's like... the number of kids in 10 schools! 🏫

The building is SO THIN at the back - only 43cm! - that it's like a giant pink screen.

A long time ago, a queen wanted to watch all the street festivals and parties happening outside. But there was a rule that royal women couldn't let people see them.

So what did the king do? He built this GENIUS building with 953 windows! She could look OUT at the parties, but people couldn't see IN! It's like the world's coolest hide-and-seek spot! 👀

The building is made of pink sandstone - SO PRETTY! When sunlight shines through all those windows, it looks like magic! ✨

If you go to Jaipur, you HAVE to see it! Try counting the windows - I bet you can't! 😄

Best time for photos? Sunrise when the light is golden, or sunset when everything turns pink! 🌅

Challenge: Take a picture of your face reflected in one of the tiny windows! 📸

hi.title: 🏰 हवा महल - हवाओं का महल!
hi.mainText: यह अनोखी इमारत 953 छोटी खिड़कियों वाली एक विशाल गुलाबी जाली जैसी दिखाई देती है! 🪟
hi.narration: जयपुर में हवा महल अपनी सैकड़ों छोटी खिड़कियों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। गुलाबी बलुआ पत्थर से बनी यह इमारत 1799 में बनाई गई थी और इसकी खिड़कियों से हवा आसानी से अंदर आती थी। 🏰

en.title: 🐪 THE AMAZING CAMEL - Desert Superhero!
en.mainText: Camels are well adapted to hot, dry environments. Their humps store fat, and their broad padded feet help them move across soft sand.

keyFacts.text: Superpower #1: Camels can survive long periods with limited water because their bodies are highly adapted to desert conditions. 💧
After being without water, a camel can drink a very large amount of water quickly. 🚰
Humps store FAT, not water! (Common mistake!) 🏔️
Superpower #2: Giant padded feet spread out like snowshoes! 👣
Superpower #3: Desert eyes! Their long eyelashes and closable nostrils help protect their eyes and nose from blowing sand. 👀
Long eyelashes block sand & dust! 🧖
Can close nostrils in sandstorms! 🌪️
Superpower #4: Can SPIT! (When angry!) 💦
Speed: Can run can run quickly when needed! 🏃
Weight: 600kg! (Like 10 kids!) 💪
Height: 3 meters! (Taller than your room!) 📏
Lifespan: 40-50 years 📅
Baby camel = calf (born WITHOUT humps!) 👶
~500,000 camels live in Rajasthan! 🐫
Pushkar Camel Fair: 50,000+ camels in November! 🎪

coolFacts.text: Camel humps are like BACKUP BATTERIES! They store fat that turns into energy and water when needed! 🔋
When a camel uses its hump energy, the hump actually SHRINKS! It's like deflating a balloon! 🎈
Camel blood is SO special that it can mix with different salt levels - perfect for desert survival! 🩸
Their padded feet spread out when they walk - like having built-in snowshoes! their broad, padded feet help them move across soft sand! 👣
Baby camels (calves) can walk within HOURS of being born! They're ready for adventure immediately! 👶
Camel teeth continue to grow and are continually worn down as the animal feeds. 🦷
The Pushkar Fair is a long-running annual cultural and livestock fair held in Rajasthan. 🎪
Camels remember people and places for YEARS - they have amazing memories! 🧠

didYouKnow.text: Camels are called 'Ships of the Desert' because traders rode them across the Sahara and Thar deserts for thousands of years! Before cars, they were an important way to travel! 🚢

tryThis.text: If you ever get to Rajasthan, ride a camel on a desert safari! It's bumpy, it's wild, and it's one of the coolest adventures you can have. Wear sunscreen and bring water for yourself (the camel won't need it!) 🐪

en.narration:
Camels are well adapted to hot, dry environments. 🐪

Their humps store fat, not water, and their broad padded feet help them walk on soft sand. Their bodies also conserve water efficiently, helping them survive in dry conditions. 💪

hi.title: 🐐 चिंकारा - राजस्थान का वन्य हिरन!
hi.mainText: चिंकारा राजस्थान के वन्य जीवों में एक सुंदर और तेज़ हिरन है। यह शुष्क इलाकों में अच्छी तरह रह सकता है।

en.title: 🏜️ THAR DESERT - India's Giant Sandbox!
en.mainText: The Thar is a vast desert region with hot summers, cool winter nights and many communities adapted to desert life. It extends across northwestern India and into Pakistan. 🏜️

keyFacts.text: Size: 200,000 km² - bigger than the UK! 📈
Hottest: very high temperatures can occur in summer! (Hotter than an oven!) 🔥
Coldest: winter nights can become very cold! (Freezing!) ❄️
Sand dunes: Some are 150 METERS tall! (40-story building!) 🏗️
Population: Millions of people live across the wider Thar region! 🏡
Desert animals: Camels, lions, desert foxes, gazelles, eagles, snakes! 🦁
Desert plants: Date palms (yummy dates!), acacia trees, cacti 🌴
Night sky: THOUSANDS of stars! You can see the Milky Way! ✨
The Thar region has a long history of human settlement and changing landscapes. 🌱
Expanding: Getting bigger because of climate change 🌍
Things to do: Camel safari, desert camping, watch sunrise/sunset! 🐪
Best time: October-March (summer is TOO HOT!) 🌞
Jaisalmer Fort: Golden fort in the middle of the desert! 🏰
Pushkar: Famous for camel fair and hot springs! 🔥
Exotic: People living in the desert have developed many ways to adapt to its climate! 🤐

coolFacts.text: The Thar Desert is one of the most POPULATED deserts in the world! Millions of people live across the Thar region! 🏡
Some sand dunes are 150 meters tall - that's like a 50-story building made of sand! 🏢
The temperature difference between day and night is CRAZY - 50°C during day, winter nights can become very cold! Your body wouldn't know what to do! 🌡️
The night sky has Dark desert skies can offer excellent opportunities for stargazing and the Milky Way galaxy across the sky! 🌌
Jaisalmer Fort is a GOLDEN FORT literally IN the middle of the desert - it glows at sunset! 🏰
The The Pushkar Fair is held annually in Rajasthan, traditionally around the Kartik Purnima period. 🎪
Thar used to be GREEN and have lots of water 4000 years ago - then climate changed! 🌊
The desert is slowly EXPANDING due to climate change - it's growing bigger every year! 🌍

didYouKnow.text: The Thar Desert is home to one of the rarest cats in the world - the Indian Desert Cat! It's smaller than a house cat and hunts at night! 🐱

tryThis.text: Visit the Thar Desert at night and lie on the sand looking up! You'll see the Milky Way galaxy stretching across the entire sky - it's so amazing that you'll forget to breathe! ✨

en.narration:
The Thar Desert is AMAZING! 🏜️

It's a heavily inhabited desert region! Millions of people live across the Thar region! How? They know incredible desert secrets passed down through their families for thousands of years!

The size is HUGE - 200,000 km²! That's BIGGER than the entire UK! Imagine that!

The sand dunes are SO TALL - some are 150 meters high! That's like looking up at a 40-story building, but made of SAND! 🏗️

The temperature swings are CRAZY! In summer it's 50°C - hotter than your home oven! But at night it drops to -5°C and it's freezing! Your body wouldn't know what to do!

But here's the COOLEST part: At night, there are NO city lights! So you can see the ENTIRE Milky Way galaxy across the sky! It looks like someone poured milk across the sky! ✨ Over 1000 stars are visible!

The Thar Desert is home to SO many cool animals:
- Camels 🐪
- Lions (wild ones!) 🦁
- Desert foxes 🦊
- Gazelles 🦌
- Eagles 🦅
- Snakes (stay away!) 🐍
- Desert lizards 🦎

And plants too! Date palms (you can eat the dates!), acacia trees, and tough desert shrubs! 🌴

Long, long ago - 4,000 years ago - this area was GREEN and had lots of water! But then the climate changed and it became a desert. Now it's slowly expanding because of climate change.

When you visit the Thar, you can:
- Ride camels across the sand! 🐪
- Sleep in desert camps under the stars! ⛺
- Watch sunsets that paint the sky orange, red, and purple! 🌅
- Watch sunrise when the sand turns golden! 🌄
- Explore Jaisalmer Fort - a golden fort in the middle of the desert! 🏰
- Visit Pushkar for the camel fair and hot springs! 🔥

Best time to visit? October to March! Summer is way too hot - stay away in June-August! 🌞

The Thar Desert teaches us that even in harsh, extreme places, life finds a way! 5 million people, thousands of animals, and amazing plants have all adapted to survive! That's the power of nature! 🌍

hi.title: 🏜️ थार रेगिस्तान - भारत का अकेला रेगिस्तान!
hi.mainText: थार भारत और पाकिस्तान के उत्तर-पश्चिम में फैला एक विशाल मरुस्थलीय क्षेत्र है।

en.title: 🏰 AMER FORT - The Hilltop Palace-Fortress!
en.mainText: A MASSIVE fort-palace on a hill near Jaipur, with mirrored halls, elephant gates, and a history of maharajas!

keyFacts.text: Built starting in 1592, over 400 years old! 📅
Made of pale yellow and pink sandstone and white marble! 🏛️
Overlooks Maota Lake below! 🌊

coolFacts.text: Inside is the Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace) - a room covered entirely in tiny mirror pieces that sparkle like stars!
Visitors used to ride up to the fort on elephants through the grand Elephant Gate!

didYouKnow.text: The Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace) inside Amer Fort is covered in thousands of tiny mirror pieces - even a single candle lights up the whole room like a starry sky!

tryThis.text: If you visit, look for the tiny mirror tiles in the Sheesh Mahal and see how they catch the light!

en.narration:
On a hill near Jaipur stands Amer Fort - a massive palace-fortress fit for maharajas! 🏰

Built starting in 1592, its pale sandstone and marble walls overlook the still waters of Maota Lake below.

Inside is a jaw-dropping surprise - the Sheesh Mahal, or Mirror Palace, where every wall and ceiling is covered in tiny pieces of mirrored glass. Light just one candle and the whole room sparkles like a night sky!

hi.title: 🏰 आमेर किला!
hi.mainText: आमेर किला जयपुर के पास एक विशाल पहाड़ी महल-किला है!
hi.narration: आमेर किला 400 साल से भी पुराना है! अंदर शीश महल है, जो हज़ारों छोटे शीशों से ढका है और एक मोमबत्ती से पूरा कमरा चमक उठता है!

en.title: 🌃 MUMBAI - Maharashtra's Dynamic Coastal Metropolis!
en.mainText: Mumbai is the capital of Maharashtra and a major centre for finance, media, culture and business.

keyFacts.text: Mumbai has a population of many millions; exact figures depend on whether the city or wider metropolitan area is counted. 🏙️
Built on 7 islands that were joined together! 🏝️
Bollywood: Where India's movie dreams come true! 🎬
Gateway of India: ICONIC building by the sea! 🚢
Marine Drive: Curved road along the beach - SO PRETTY! 🌊
Home of CRICKET! - India's cricket heroes! 🏏
Street food: Vada Pav, Pav Bhaji, Pani Puri 🍜
Best time to visit: October-March 🌤️

coolFacts.text: Mumbai was made from 7 islands by filling them together - like a giant puzzle! 🧩
The Gateway of India was built in 1924 - that's about a century ago! It's WHERE you ARRIVE in Mumbai! ⛩️
Marine Drive is curved like a crescent moon - people call it the 'Queen's Necklace' at night with all the lights! 💎
Mumbai is a major centre of India's Hindi-language film industry, popularly known as Bollywood. 🎬
Mumbai is the financial capital of India - money, stocks, and business happen here! 💰
The Taj Mahal Palace opened in 1903 and is one of Mumbai's best-known historic hotels. 🏨

didYouKnow.text: Mumbai used to be called 'Bombay' until 1995! The name changed to 'Mumbai' after the goddess Mumbadevi! 🙏 So Mumbai is BLESSED by a goddess!

tryThis.text: Watch a Bollywood movie! They're fun, colorful, and have AMAZING dances and songs! You'll see why India LOVES Bollywood! 🎥 Try 'Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge' or 'Lagaan'!

en.narration: Mumbai is the capital of Maharashtra and a major centre for finance, business, media, culture and the Hindi-language film industry. The city grew from a group of islands that were gradually connected. 🌃

mr.title: 🏛️ मुंबई - महाराष्ट्र का महानगर!
mr.mainText: मुंबई महाराष्ट्र की राजधानी और भारत का एक प्रमुख महानगर है। यह वित्त, सिनेमा, व्यापार और पर्यटन का महत्वपूर्ण केंद्र है।
mr.narration: मुंबई महाराष्ट्र की राजधानी है और भारत के प्रमुख महानगरों में से एक है। यह वित्त, व्यापार, सिनेमा और पर्यटन के लिए जानी जाती है। गेटवे ऑफ इंडिया और मरीन ड्राइव इसके प्रसिद्ध स्थल हैं। मुंबई में अलग-अलग भाषाओं और संस्कृतियों के लोग साथ रहते हैं।

en.title: 🗣️ MARATHI - The Language of Warriors!
en.mainText: Marathi is the principal language of Maharashtra and is spoken by millions of people. It has a long literary tradition and is written mainly in Devanagari. 🗣️

keyFacts.text: Marathi is spoken by millions of people in Maharashtra and elsewhere in India. 🌍
MARATHI = Language of the MARATHAS! ⚔️
NAMASTE = Hello 🙏
SHUKRIYA = Thank you 💚
VADA PAV = Potato fritter + bread 🍲
SAHITYA = Literature 📚
KALA = Art 🎨
SHIVAJI = Famous WARRIOR KING! 👑
Written in Devanagari script like Hindi! ⛰️
Marathi has a long literary history spanning many centuries. 📖

coolFacts.text: Marathi was an important language of the Maratha period, including the time of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. ⚔️
Marathi has been spoken for OVER 800 YEARS! It's an OLD and PROUD language! 👑
Marathi poetry is FAMOUS! Poets like Tukaram wrote poems that people still SING and LOVE! 🎵
Marathi uses Devanagari script - same as Hindi! But the words are BOLD and POWERFUL! 💪
Many FAMOUS people speak Marathi: Gandiji, many Bollywood stars, and business leaders! 🌟
Marathi has influenced many languages in South Asia because of Maratha warriors spreading it! 🗺️

didYouKnow.text: Shivaji Maharaj, the WARRIOR KING of the Marathas, spoke Marathi! He was so powerful that even the Mughals feared him! Every Marathi word carries the spirit of warriors! 👑⚔️

tryThis.text: Learn Marathi words: NAMASTE (hello), SHUKRIYA (thank you), VADA (potato fritter), and JAIS (victory/win)! Say them with POWER and PRIDE! 💪

en.narration: Marathi is the principal language of Maharashtra and has a rich literary history. It is written mainly in the Devanagari script and is spoken by millions of people. 🗣️

mr.title: 🗣️ मराठी - महाराष्ट्र की भाषा!
mr.mainText: मराठी महाराष्ट्र की प्रमुख भाषा है और इसे देवनागरी लिपि में लिखा जाता है।
mr.narration: मराठी महाराष्ट्र की प्रमुख भाषा है और भारत की प्रमुख भाषाओं में से एक है। इसे देवनागरी लिपि में लिखा जाता है। महाराष्ट्र में मराठी के साथ कई दूसरी भाषाएँ भी बोली जाती हैं।

en.title: 🍲 VADA PAV - The Street Food KING!
en.mainText: Golden-fried potato fritters (vada) + soft bread (pav) = CRISPY on outside, CREAMY inside! The BEST street food in India! 😋

keyFacts.text: VADA = Potato fritter dipped in spicy batter 🥔
PAV = Soft white bread roll 🍞
Together = MAGIC! 💫
Prices vary by shop and time; there is no single current price for vada pav. 💰
A popular snack enjoyed across Maharashtra and beyond! 👥 👥
Street vendors make them in oil at traffic lights! 🚦
Crispy outside, soft inside - CONTRAST PERFECTION! ✨
Goes with: Dry garlic chutney, sweet tamarind, spicy red chutney 🌶️
So popular it's called 'Mumbai's BURGER'! 🍔
Even seen in movies and Bollywood songs! 🎬

coolFacts.text: Vada Pav is called 'the poor man's meal' because it's so CHEAP and FILLING! 💰 But even RICH people LOVE it!
A vada is basically a POTATO BALL fried until it's GOLDEN and CRISPY! When you bite it - CRUNCH! 🎉
The pav is soft and sweet - it BALANCES the spicy vada! Together they're PERFECT! 🎭
Street vendors make vada pav RIGHT IN FRONT OF YOU! You can see the oil bubbling and the golden color! 👀
Mumbai has about 40,000 vada pav stalls! That's like... vada pav on EVERY CORNER! 📍
There's even a Vada Pav Festival in Mumbai every year! 🎪

didYouKnow.text: Vada Pav is so important to Mumbai that it's called the 'INSIDER'S FOOD' or 'MUMBAI'S BURGER'! Every Mumbaikar eats it, from busy office workers to Bollywood stars! 🌟

tryThis.text: If you visit Mumbai, eat vada pav from a street vendor! Watch them make it, see the oil, smell the aroma! Dip it in green chutney and take a BIG bite! It's crispy, it's tasty, it's PURE JOY! 😋

en.narration: Vada pav is a popular Mumbai street food made with a spiced potato fritter served in a bread roll. Prices vary by place and time, so there is no single current price for the dish. 🍲

mr.title: 🍲 वडा पाव - स्ट्रीट फूडचा राजा!
mr.mainText: सोनेरी तळलेला बटाटा वडा आणि मऊ पाव यांची जोडी - बाहेरून कुरकुरीत, आतून मऊ!
mr.narration: वड़ा पाव मुंबई का बहुत लोकप्रिय स्ट्रीट फूड है। मसालेदार आलू का वडा नरम पाव के साथ परोसा जाता है। इसे चटनी और मसालों के साथ खाना बहुत मज़ेदार लगता है!

en.title: 🚢 GATEWAY OF INDIA - The WELCOME GATE!
en.mainText: THE MOST ICONIC building in Mumbai! It stands by the SEA like a GIANT ARCH welcoming everyone to India! Built by the British, but OWNED by Indians! 🏛️

keyFacts.text: Built in 1924 and now more than a century old. 📅
Built by the British but NOW it's INDIA'S SYMBOL! 🇮🇳
Stands RIGHT by the Arabian Sea! 🌊
65 meters TALL! (Like a 20-story building!) 🏢
Made of YELLOW BASALT STONE! ✨
Looks like a GIANT ARCH or GATE! 🏛️
The Gateway of India is one of Mumbai's best-known waterfront landmarks. 👀
Thousands of visitors EVERY DAY! 👥
Beautiful at SUNSET! 🌅
Nearby: Taj Mahal Hotel, Marine Drive, Colaba 🏨

coolFacts.text: The Gateway was built to welcome the BRITISH KING George V in 1924! But now it WELCOMES THE WORLD! 👑
It's made of YELLOW BASALT STONE from a quarry in Gujarat! The yellow color is SO STRIKING! ⚡
The arch is PERFECTLY SYMMETRIC - photographers LOVE taking pictures here! 📸
At night, the gateway is LIT UP with beautiful lights! It looks like a GOLDEN ARCH glowing against the sky! ✨
Marine life nearby: You can sometimes see DOLPHINS in the Arabian Sea near the Gateway! 🐬
The Gateway of India is one of Mumbai's most photographed and recognisable landmarks. 📱

didYouKnow.text: The Gateway of India was ORIGINALLY built to welcome British royalty, but TODAY it's the SYMBOL of Mumbai and INDIA! It welcomed Indian freedom fighters during independence! Now it welcomes EVERYONE! 🇮🇳

tryThis.text: Visit the Gateway of India at SUNSET! The yellow stone turns GOLDEN, the sky turns PINK and ORANGE, and the Arabian Sea glows! Take a photo where the sun, the gateway, and the ocean are all PERFECT! 📸

en.narration:
The Gateway of India is the SOUL of Mumbai! 🚢

Imagine a GIANT ARCH standing right by the ocean, 65 meters tall! That's like looking up at a 20-story building made of beautiful yellow stone! ✨

It was built in 1924 to welcome British royalty, but TODAY it's the SYMBOL of India and Mumbai! It's been welcoming everyone for 100 YEARS! 📅

The gateway is made of YELLOW BASALT STONE from Gujarat! The color is SO STRIKING that when the sun hits it, it GLOWS! When sunset happens, it turns GOLDEN! 🌅

The arch is PERFECTLY SYMMETRIC - like someone drew it with a RULER! Photographers go CRAZY here! Millions of photos are taken EVERY YEAR! 📸

But here's the COOLEST part: It stands RIGHT by the Arabian Sea! 🌊 The ocean waves crash nearby, and if you're lucky, you can see DOLPHINS! 🐬

At night, when the lights come on, the Gateway looks like a GOLDEN ARCH glowing in the darkness! It's MAGICAL! ✨

The Gateway also watched HISTORY! It welcomed the RETURN of Indian freedom fighters after independence! 🇮🇳

When you visit Mumbai, standing at the Gateway of India at sunset is a MUST-DO! The colors, the energy, the EMOTIONS - it's like stepping into a POSTCARD! 📮

mr.title: 🚢 गेटवे ऑफ इंडिया - स्वागत द्वार!
mr.mainText: मुंबईतील सर्वात प्रसिद्ध इमारत! ती समुद्रकिनारी एका भव्य कमानीसारखी उभी आहे!
mr.narration: गेटवे ऑफ इंडिया ही मुंबईतील सर्वात प्रतिष्ठित इमारत आहे! ती अरबी समुद्राच्या किनारी एका भव्य कमानीसारखी उभी आहे, जी येणाऱ्या प्रत्येकाचे स्वागत करते. इंग्रजांनी ती बांधली, पण आज ती भारताची शान आहे!

en.title: 🐿️ INDIAN GIANT SQUIRREL - Maharashtra's Rainbow Acrobat!
en.mainText: Maharashtra's official state animal is a squirrel the size of a cat, with fur in FOUR different colors! It can leap 6 meters between trees! 🌈

keyFacts.text: Official state animal of Maharashtra! 🏆
Also called the Shekru! 🐿️
Body length: up to 36 cm, plus a bushy tail almost as long! 📏
Fur colors: maroon, cream, black and brown patches - like a rainbow! 🌈
Can leap up to 6 meters between tree branches! 🌳
Lives high in the forest canopy - rarely comes down! 🌲
Found in Bhimashankar Wildlife Sanctuary, Western Ghats! ⛰️
Builds several large nests high in trees! 🪺
Eats fruits, nuts, flowers and bark! 🥭
Mostly active at dawn and dusk! 🌅

coolFacts.text: Bhimashankar Sanctuary was created specifically to protect this squirrel! 🌳
It's one of the largest squirrels in the world! 🐿️
Its 4-color coat works as camouflage in dappled forest light! 🌈
It rarely touches the ground its entire life! 🌲
Local Warli tribal art often features this squirrel! 🎨

didYouKnow.text: The Indian Giant Squirrel is so good at jumping that it can leap 6 meters - that's further than a car is long - from one tree to another, using its long tail for balance! 🐿️

tryThis.text: Try jumping as far as you can, then imagine jumping SIX TIMES that distance - that's a normal day for this squirrel! 🦘

en.narration:
Maharashtra's official state animal isn't a tiger or a lion - it's a squirrel! But not just any squirrel. 🐿️

The Indian Giant Squirrel is almost as big as a cat, with a coat of maroon, cream, black and brown patches, like it's wearing a rainbow costume! 🌈

It lives high up in the trees of the Western Ghats, especially in Bhimashankar Wildlife Sanctuary, and can leap an amazing 6 meters between branches using its long, fluffy tail for balance. It almost never comes down to the ground! 🌳

mr.title: 🐿️ भारतीय महाकाय खार - महाराष्ट्राची रंगीबेरंगी कसरतपटू!
mr.mainText: महाराष्ट्राचा राज्य प्राणी ही मांजराएवढी खार आहे, जिला चार वेगवेगळे रंग असतात!
mr.narration: हिला 'शेकरू' असेही म्हणतात. ही खार झाडांमध्ये 6 मीटरपर्यंत उडी मारू शकते, आणि तिचा रंग मरून, मलई, काळा आणि तपकिरी - इंद्रधनुष्यासारखा असतो!

en.title: 🌲 WESTERN GHATS - Mountain TREASURE!
en.mainText: UNESCO WORLD HERITAGE site! The Western Ghats are recognised as one of the world's biodiversity hotspots. thousands of plant species! thousands of animal species! MAGICAL! 🌿

keyFacts.text: Length: 1600 km - stretches along India's west coast! 🗺️
Highest peak: Anamudi (2695m) in Kerala! 🏔️
UNESCO World Heritage Site! 🏅
Biodiversity hotspot: One of the TOP 5 in the world! 🌍
thousands of plant species! (Crazy!) 🌿
thousands of animal species! 🦁
2500+ insect species! 🦋
Rainfall: One of the WETTEST places in India! ☔
Waterfalls: Hundreds of them! 💧
Tigers, leopards, bisons, monkeys, birds! 👀
Sacred for tribes who lived here for centuries! 🙏
Spice gardens: Cardamom, pepper, turmeric! 🌶️

coolFacts.text: The Western Ghats occupy a relatively small part of India but contain exceptionally rich biodiversity and many endemic species. 🦁
Many species in the Western Ghats are endemic, meaning they occur naturally nowhere else. 🌿
The Ghats get SO MUCH RAIN - up to 9 METERS per year in some places! That's taller than your house! ☔
Ancient kings built SPICE GARDENS on the slopes - cardamom, pepper, turmeric! They're STILL there! 🌶️
Indigenous tribes have lived here for THOUSANDS of years! They know the forest like the back of their hand! 🙏
Climate change is making these mountains hotter and drier - we need to PROTECT them! 🌍

didYouKnow.text: The Western Ghats is SO IMPORTANT for biodiversity that it's called a 'BIODIVERSITY HOTSPOT'! That means it has MORE unique species than almost ANYWHERE else on Earth! 🌿

tryThis.text: Visit a Western Ghats trek near Mumbai! You'll see mountains covered in green, waterfalls everywhere, and if you're lucky, wild animals like monkeys, deer, and maybe even a leopard! The SMELLS of the forest are AMAZING! 🏔️

en.narration: The Western Ghats are a UNESCO World Heritage property and an important biodiversity hotspot. They stretch for about 1,600 kilometres along India's western side and contain many species found nowhere else. 🌿

mr.title: 🌲 पश्चिम घाट - डोंगरांचा खजिना!
mr.mainText: युनेस्को जागतिक वारसा स्थळ! जगातील सर्वात समृद्ध जैवविविधता असलेल्या ठिकाणांपैकी एक! 8000+ वनस्पती प्रजाती!
mr.narration: पश्चिम घाट महाराष्ट्रातून जातात आणि युनेस्को जागतिक वारसा स्थळ आहेत! इथे 8000 पेक्षा जास्त वनस्पती प्रजाती आणि 2000 पेक्षा जास्त प्राणी प्रजाती आढळतात - हे खरोखर जादुई आहे!

en.title: 🕌 AJANTA CAVES - Ancient Paintings in Stone!
en.mainText: 30 rock-cut caves carved into a cliff over 2,000 years ago, filled with stunning ancient paintings and sculptures!

keyFacts.text: Carved between 200 BCE and 480 CE! 📅
30 caves cut directly into a horseshoe-shaped cliff! 🏞️
A UNESCO World Heritage Site! 🌍

coolFacts.text: The caves were hidden and forgotten for centuries, covered by jungle, until a British officer accidentally rediscovered them in 1819!
Some paintings inside are so well preserved that their colors still look vivid after 1,500+ years!

didYouKnow.text: The Ajanta Caves were completely lost to the world, hidden by jungle, until a British army officer stumbled upon them by accident in 1819 while out tiger hunting!

tryThis.text: If you visit, look closely at the ancient paintings - see if you can spot scenes of elephants, dancers, and royal courts!

en.narration:
Carved into a horseshoe-shaped cliff in Maharashtra are the Ajanta Caves - 30 caves filled with paintings over 1,500 years old! 🕌

Buddhist monks carved these caves between 200 BCE and 480 CE, decorating the walls with incredibly detailed paintings and sculptures.

Here's the wild part - the caves were completely forgotten, swallowed by jungle, until a British officer accidentally found them in 1819 while out hunting tigers!

mr.title: 🕌 अजिंठा लेणी!
mr.mainText: अजिंठा लेणी म्हणजे कड्यात कोरलेल्या 30 गुंफा आहेत, प्राचीन चित्रांनी भरलेल्या!
mr.narration: या गुंफा जंगलात हरवल्या होत्या, 1819 मध्ये एका ब्रिटिश अधिकाऱ्याला अपघाताने सापडल्या!

en.title: 💻 BENGALURU - India's Technology Hub!
en.mainText: Bengaluru is the capital of Karnataka and a major centre for technology, startups, education and research.

keyFacts.text: Called major technology hub of India! 💻
Population: millions of people live in the Bengaluru urban area! 🏙️
Tech companies: Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, Meta! 🌍
Bengaluru is known for a comparatively mild climate, though temperatures vary by season. 😎
Vidhana Soudha: Massive government building! 🏛️
Cubbon Park: Beautiful park with trees & lakes! 🌳
IT corridor: Where tech dreams come TRUE! 💡
Bengaluru has a large student, technology and working-age population. 👨‍👩‍👧
Coffee culture: Coffee cafes EVERYWHERE! ☕
Startup hub: Hundreds of new companies START here! 🚀

coolFacts.text: Bengaluru grew from a historic city into a major technology and business centre over the past several decades. 📈
Bengaluru is one of India's major technology and startup centres. 💼
Google, Microsoft, Amazon have HUGE offices here - some buildings are TALLER than the Statue of Liberty! 🏢
Bengaluru is known as the Garden City because of its parks and tree-lined areas. 🌺
Vidhana Soudha took 4 YEARS to build and is made of PINK STONE! It's MASSIVE! 🏛️
Cubbon Park has 300 acres of PURE GREEN - it's like a FOREST in the middle of the city! 🌳

didYouKnow.text: Bangalore's transformation from a small village to the major technology hub of India is one of the rapid urban growth! In just 50 years! 🚀

tryThis.text: Visit a startup accelerator or tech campus in Bangalore! See where India's tech future is being BUILT! Or just explore Cubbon Park and enjoy the cool weather while eating ice cream! 🍦

en.narration: Bengaluru is the capital of Karnataka and one of India's leading technology and startup centres. It is also known for its parks, universities and comparatively mild climate. 💻

kn.title: 🏛️ बेंगलुरु - तकनीकी शहर!
kn.mainText: बेंगलुरु कर्नाटक की राजधानी और भारत का एक प्रमुख तकनीकी तथा स्टार्टअप केंद्र है।
kn.narration: बेंगलुरु कर्नाटक की राजधानी है और भारत के प्रमुख तकनीकी केंद्रों में से एक है। यहाँ कई तकनीकी कंपनियाँ और स्टार्टअप काम करते हैं। शहर में आधुनिक जीवन के साथ पुराने पेड़-पौधे और कई सांस्कृतिक जगहें भी हैं।

en.title: 🗣️ KANNADA - The ROYAL Language!
en.mainText: Kannada is spoken by millions of people! It's one of the OLDEST languages in India - a long literary history! Written in beautiful curves!

keyFacts.text: Spoken by millions of people (millions)! 🌍
ONE OF THE OLDEST LANGUAGES - a language with a long recorded literary history! 👑
Official language of Karnataka! 🏛️
KANNADA = Language of the land! 🌏
Written in Kannada script - looks like flowing water! 💧
NAMASTE = Hello 🙏
SHUKRIYA = Thank you 💚
COFFEE = KAAPI (sounds fun!) ☕
IDLI = IDDALAY (crispy rice cake) 🍲
Famous authors: Pampa, Ranna, Kuvempu! 📚

coolFacts.text: Kannada is SO OLD that it's mentioned in ANCIENT SANSKRIT texts! It has 2000+ years of CONTINUOUS history! 👑
Kannada script looks like it's FLOWING - like water or wind! Each letter is CURVED and BEAUTIFUL! 💧
Many FAMOUS POETS wrote in Kannada! Their poems are STILL sung and loved! 🎵
Kannada influenced many languages in South India! It's a POWERFUL language! 💪
Kannada literature has AMAZING stories - about heroes, love, adventure, and wisdom! 📖
Modern Kannada is EVOLVING with tech terms - coders mix Kannada and English! 💻

didYouKnow.text: Kannada was declared a CLASSICAL LANGUAGE by the Indian government in 2008! That means it's one of India's MOST ANCIENT and IMPORTANT languages! 👑

tryThis.text: Learn Kannada words: NAMASTE (hello), SHUKRIYA (thank you), KAAPI (coffee), and IDDALAY (idli)! Kannada sounds SO MELODIOUS! 🎵

en.narration:
Kannada is a language with a long literary tradition! 👑

It's spoken by millions of people - that's millions! And it's a long literary history! That means your great-great-great... (go back 2000 times!) ...grandparents spoke Kannada! 📖

Kannada script is BEAUTIFUL! Each letter looks like it's FLOWING - like water or wind! 💧 When you write it, it's like PAINTING!

The government recognized Kannada as a CLASSICAL LANGUAGE in 2008! That means it's one of India's MOST PRECIOUS and ANCIENT languages! 🏛️

Many FAMOUS POETS wrote in Kannada! Their words were SO POWERFUL that people still SING and LOVE them even today! 🎵

Here are cool Kannada words:
- NAMASTE = Hello! 🙏
- SHUKRIYA = Thank you! 💚
- KAAPI = Coffee! ☕
- IDDALAY = Idli (rice cake)! 🍲

Kannada literature has AMAZING stories:
- Stories of HEROES and KINGS! 👑
- Stories of LOVE and ADVENTURE! 💕
- Stories of WISDOM and MAGIC! ✨

Today, coders in Bangalore mix Kannada with English and TECH words! It's EVOLVING and GROWING! 💻

Every time you speak Kannada, you're speaking a language that's been ALIVE for 2000 YEARS! That's INCREDIBLE! 🌍

kn.title: 🗣️ ಕನ್ನಡ - ನಮ್ಮ ಭಾಷೆ!
kn.mainText: कन्नड़ कर्नाटक की प्रमुख भाषा है और यह द्रविड़ भाषा परिवार से संबंधित है।
kn.narration: कन्नड़ कर्नाटक की प्रमुख भाषा है। यह एक द्रविड़ भाषा है और इसकी समृद्ध साहित्यिक परंपरा है।

en.title: 🍲 IDLI - The SOFTEST, FLUFFIEST Breakfast!
en.mainText: IDLI = White steamed cake made from RICE and LENTILS! So soft it melts in your mouth! So healthy! The popular breakfast! 😋

keyFacts.text: Idli = Steamed rice & lentil cake 🍚
Fluffy, soft, WHITE like clouds! ☁️
Takes only 30 minutes to make! ⏰
nutritious - no oil, no sugar! 💪
popular breakfast food! 🌅
Served with: Sambar (lentil soup), Chutney 🥘
Made in a special IDLI MAKER! 🔧
Ancient food - a dish with a long history! 👑
Eaten by MILLIONS every day across South India! 🌍
Can be stored for 2-3 days! 📦

coolFacts.text: Idli is SO SOFT that it literally MELTS in your mouth! No chewing needed! 😋
Making idli is a SCIENCE! The batter needs to ferment overnight to become FLUFFY! 🧪
Idli is made in a SPECIAL CYLINDRICAL MOLD! When you push it out - PLOP! A perfect circle! 🔧
An idli has only 40-50 CALORIES but is SUPER filling! Perfect for healthy eating! 💪
Idli is SO BLAND on its own that it NEEDS sambar and chutney for flavor! Together = MAGIC! 🎭
Idli was has a long history in South India! Now it's eaten EVERYWHERE in India! 🌍

didYouKnow.text: Idli is sometimes called 'the nutritious and versatile food' because it's HEALTHY, EASY TO DIGEST, and TASTY! Even BABIES and old people eat it! 👶

tryThis.text: Watch someone make idli! See how they ferment the batter, pour it in the mold, and steam it! Then eat it fresh and HOT with sambar and chutney! It's COMFORT FOOD at its FINEST! 😋

en.narration: Idli is a steamed South Indian food commonly made from fermented rice and black gram batter. It is widely eaten across India and beyond. 🍲

kn.title: 🍲 इडली-डोसा - दक्षिण का स्वाद!
kn.mainText: इडली और डोसा दक्षिण भारत के लोकप्रिय व्यंजन हैं और कर्नाटक में भी बहुत पसंद किए जाते हैं।
kn.narration: ಇಡ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಡೋಸೆ ಭಾರತದ ಮಿಷ್ಟಾನ್ನ ಪಿತಾಮಹ!

en.title: 🏰 MYSORE PALACE - The GOLDEN PALACE!
en.mainText: ONE OF THE famous PALACES IN INDIA! Covered in PINK and GOLD! Has 200+ rooms! Looks like something from a FAIRY TALE! ✨

keyFacts.text: Built in 1897 (125+ years old!) 📅
Made of PINK and GOLDEN stone! ✨
200+ rooms! Can you count them all? 🏛️
Dome: SO TALL it looks like it touches the sky! 🏔️
Each room: Full of intricate carvings and decorations! 🎨
Eastern Gate: Made of SOLID SILVER! 🥈
The Royal Family: STILL lives here! 👑
Dussehra Festival: Entire palace is lit with 100,000+ lights! 💡
Museum inside: You can see royal treasures! 💎
Gardens: Beautiful landscaped gardens! 🌳

coolFacts.text: Mysore Palace is so GOLDEN that it literally GLOWS in the sunset! 🌅 Photographers go CRAZY!
The palace was built using the BEST materials from ALL OVER INDIA! Marble from Rajasthan, granite from Karnataka! 🏗️
Each room is a MASTERPIECE! Intricate carvings, paintings, chandeliers, and decorations! 🎨
The Silver Eastern Gate weighs TONS but opens SO SMOOTHLY! Ancient engineering GENIUS! 🥈
During Dussehra, 100,000+ lights illuminate the ENTIRE palace! It looks like the palace is FLOATING in LIGHT! 💡
The Royal Family STILL LIVES in the palace! It's not just a museum - it's a real HOME for a real KING! 👑

didYouKnow.text: Mysore Palace was built over 125 years ago but it's STILL one of the famous buildings in India! It's a LIVING palace - the royal family actually lives here! 👑

tryThis.text: Visit Mysore Palace during Dussehra Festival in September-October! The ENTIRE palace is lit with 100,000+ lights! It's like seeing a PALACE MADE OF LIGHT! 💡✨

en.narration:
Mysore Palace is a DREAM made of STONE! 🏰

Imagine a MASSIVE palace made of PINK and GOLDEN stone! It looks like something from a FAIRY TALE! ✨

The palace has 200+ ROOMS! Each one is filled with INTRICATE CARVINGS, PAINTINGS, and DECORATIONS! 🎨 It took workers YEARS to carve and decorate everything!

The dome is SO TALL that it looks like it's touching the SKY! When you look up - WOW! 🏔️

The Eastern Gate is made of SOLID SILVER! It's SO HEAVY but opens so SMOOTHLY - ancient engineering GENIUS! 🥈

BUT here's the COOLEST part: The Royal Family STILL LIVES HERE! It's not just a museum - it's a REAL HOME for a REAL KING! 👑 How cool is that?

During the DUSSEHRA FESTIVAL (September-October), the entire palace is ILLUMINATED with 100,000+ LIGHTS! 💡 It's like the palace is MADE OF LIGHT! The whole thing GLOWS! ✨

At SUNSET, the pink and golden stone catches the light and the palace LITERALLY GLOWS GOLDEN! 🌅 Photographers from around the WORLD come to take pictures!

Inside, there are:
- Royal treasures 💎
- Ancient artifacts 🏺
- Beautiful gardens 🌳
- Throne rooms 👑
- Private chambers 🛏️

When you visit, you can:
- Walk through the grand halls 🚶
- See the royal treasures 💎
- Take photos in the golden light 📸
- Experience royalty! 👑

Mysore Palace teaches us that BEAUTY and GRANDEUR can last CENTURIES! 🏰

kn.title: 🏰 ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆ - ಚಿನ್ನದ ಅರಮನೆ!
kn.mainText: ಭಾರತದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸುಂದರ ಅರಮನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು! ಗುಲಾಬಿ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿನ್ನದ ಬಣ್ಣದಿಂದ ಆವೃತವಾಗಿದೆ!
kn.narration: ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆ 1897ರಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣವಾಯಿತು! ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ 200ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೊಠಡಿಗಳಿವೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರ್ವ ದ್ವಾರ ಶುದ್ಧ ಬೆಳ್ಳಿಯಿಂದ ಮಾಡಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ!

en.title: 🐘 INDIAN ELEPHANT - The GENTLE GIANT!
en.mainText: The Asian elephant is the largest land animal in Asia and can weigh several tonnes. 🐘 Has amazing MEMORY! Can pick up things with its TRUNK! So SMART and LOVING! 💚

keyFacts.text: Weight: 5000 kg! (Like 80 adult humans!) 💪
Height: 3 meters at shoulder! (Taller than a basketball hoop!) 🏀
Trunk: 40,000+ muscles! Can pick up a PEANUT! 🌰
Ears: Can be 4 meters long! (Size of a car!) 🚗
Memory: NEVER forgets! 🧠
Lifespan: 60-70 years! (Almost human!) 👴
Diet: Eats 200 kg of food per day! 🍌
Lives in: Western Ghats, South India forests 🌲
Baby: Called a CALF - born 2 kg! 👶
Social: Lives in herds, VERY family-oriented! 👥

coolFacts.text: Indian Elephants have AMAZING memories! They remember people, places, and even other elephants for DECADES! 🧠
The trunk has 40,000+ MUSCLES! That's more muscles than a human has bones! 💪 And it's SO sensitive that it can pick up a SINGLE PEANUT! 🌰
Elephants are SO INTELLIGENT that they recognize themselves in mirrors! They're SELF-AWARE! 🪞
Baby elephants stay with their mothers for YEARS! They learn everything from mom! 👶
Elephants communicate with SOUNDS we can't hear - called infrasound! It travels for MILES! 📢
In temples, elephants are HONORED and BLESSED! They're sacred animals! 🙏

didYouKnow.text: Indian Elephants are so IMPORTANT to Indian culture that they're in temples, festivals, and even royal ceremonies! They're not just animals - they're RESPECTED and LOVED! 🐘

tryThis.text: Visit an elephant sanctuary in Karnataka where you can see wild elephants! Watch them move, eat, communicate! If possible, feed an elephant and feel their TRUNK - it's AMAZING! 🐘

en.narration:
Indian Elephants are the KINGS of the forest! 🐘

They're the LARGEST land animals in ENTIRE ASIA! 💪 Weigh 5000 kg - that's like 80 ADULT HUMANS!

At 3 meters tall at the shoulder, they're TALLER than a basketball hoop! 🏀

But here's the MOST AMAZING part: The TRUNK! 🌿 It has 40,000+ MUSCLES! That's MORE muscles than a human has BONES! And it's SO SENSITIVE that an elephant can pick up a SINGLE PEANUT! 🌰

Elephants have INCREDIBLE MEMORY! They NEVER FORGET! 🧠 They remember people, places, and other elephants for DECADES! If an elephant saw you 20 YEARS AGO, it might REMEMBER YOU!

Elephants are SO INTELLIGENT that they:
- Recognize themselves in mirrors! 🪞
- Use tools! 🔧
- Feel EMOTIONS! 💚
- Mourn their dead! 😢

They live in FAMILY GROUPS called HERDS! Baby elephants (called calves) stay with their mothers for YEARS and learn EVERYTHING! 👶

Here's something INCREDIBLE: Elephants can communicate with SOUNDS we CAN'T HEAR! Called INFRASOUND! It travels for MILES! 📢 So two elephants far apart can still "TALK" to each other!

Elephants eat 200 kg of FOOD PER DAY! 🍌 Bananas, leaves, bark, fruits - they're always EATING!

In India, elephants are HONORED! They're in TEMPLES, FESTIVALS, and ROYAL CEREMONIES! 🙏 They're not just animals - they're RESPECTED and SACRED!

When you visit Karnataka, seeing a wild elephant is a PRIVILEGE! Watch their GRACE, their INTELLIGENCE, their LOVE for their family! 🐘

kn.title: 🐘 हाथी - जंगल का विशाल जीव!
kn.mainText: हाथी कर्नाटक के जंगलों में पाए जाने वाले बड़े और बुद्धिमान वन्य जीव हैं।

en.title: ☕ COFFEE PLANTATIONS - The COFFEE FOREST!
en.mainText: Karnataka is a major coffee-producing state in India, with coffee plantations concentrated in its hill districts. ☕🌿

keyFacts.text: Karnataka is one of India’s major coffee-producing states! ☕ ☕
Plantations in Western Ghats & Nilgiris! 🏔️
Area: 250,000+ acres! (Size of a big city!) 📈
Two types: Arabica & Robusta beans! 🌿
Height: Coffee grows on hills at 3000+ feet elevation! 🏔️
Climate: Cool, misty, perfect for coffee! 🌫️
Shade-grown: Trees protect coffee plants! 🌳
Harvest: Hand-picked between October-December! 🍂
Processing: Beans dried, roasted, packaged! 🔥
World quality: Karnataka coffee is WORLD-FAMOUS! 🌍

coolFacts.text: Coffee was brought to Karnataka by an Arab saint in the 1600s! Now it's EVERYWHERE! ☕
Walking through a coffee plantation smells like HEAVEN! The aroma is SO STRONG! 👃
Coffee plants grow on HILLSIDES under SHADE TREES - it's like a green FOREST! 🌳
A single coffee plant produces only about 200 grams of roasted coffee per YEAR! That's why coffee is PRECIOUS! 💎
Karnataka coffee is exported to over 80 COUNTRIES! The WHOLE WORLD drinks it! 🌍
Coffee plantations are homes to RARE BIRDS, ANIMALS, and INSECTS! They're ecosystems! 🦜

didYouKnow.text: Karnataka's coffee is so GOOD that it's one of the MOST EXPORTED agricultural products from India! It's known for its RICH FLAVOR and SMOOTH TASTE! ☕

tryThis.text: Visit a coffee plantation during harvest season (October-December)! See workers hand-picking coffee beans, walk through the green rows, and drink FRESH coffee brewed from beans picked THAT DAY! 🌿☕

en.narration:
Karnataka is the COFFEE KINGDOM of India! ☕

70% of ALL Indian coffee comes from here! That's HUGE! 🌍

Imagine MILLIONS of coffee plants growing on BEAUTIFUL GREEN HILLSIDES! 🏔️ That's what Karnataka looks like!

Coffee was brought to Karnataka by an Arab saint in the 1600s! And since then, it's been GROWING and GROWING! ☕

The coffee grows in the WESTERN GHATS and NILGIRIS mountains - cool, misty places at 3000+ feet elevation! 🌫️ The cool weather is PERFECT for coffee!

Walking through a coffee plantation is MAGICAL! 🌳 The smell of coffee is SO STRONG that you can TASTE it in the AIR! 👃

Coffee plants grow UNDER SHADE TREES! It's like a GREEN FOREST with coffee hiding underneath! This is called SHADE-GROWN COFFEE and it's the BEST! 🌿

During HARVEST (October-December), workers hand-pick every coffee bean! 🍂 It takes SO MUCH WORK! But the beans are PERFECT!

Here's something AMAZING: A single coffee plant produces only about 200 grams of ROASTED coffee per YEAR! That's why coffee is PRECIOUS! 💎

After harvest:
1. Beans are DRIED in the sun ☀️
2. Beans are ROASTED to bring out flavor 🔥
3. Beans are PACKAGED and shipped to the world! 📦

Karnataka's coffee is exported to over 80 COUNTRIES! The whole WORLD drinks it! 🌍

Coffee plantations are also HOME to rare birds, animals, and insects! They're ECOSYSTEMS! 🦜

When you visit a coffee plantation:
- See green HILLS covered in coffee plants 🏔️
- Smell the AMAZING aroma 👃
- Watch workers hand-pick beans 🍂
- Drink FRESH coffee! ☕
- Feel like you're in a GREEN DREAM! 🌳

kn.title: ☕ ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಗಳು - ಕಾಫಿ ಕಾಡು!
kn.mainText: कर्नाटक भारत के प्रमुख कॉफी उत्पादक राज्यों में से एक है। इसके पहाड़ी इलाकों में कई कॉफी बागान हैं।
kn.narration: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗಾಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಫಿಯ ಪರಿಮಳ ಸದಾ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ! ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ಶೇಕಡಾ 70ರಷ್ಟು ಕಾಫಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

en.title: 🏛️ VIDHANA SOUDHA - The Government Palace!
en.mainText: One of INDIA'S famous government buildings! A STUNNING dome structure built in Dravidian-British architectural style!

keyFacts.text: Completed in 1956 - the year India became a Republic! 🇮🇳
Built in neoclassical Dravidian architecture - SO UNIQUE! 🏛️
Houses the LEGISLATURE and SECRETARIAT of Karnataka! 📜
The dome is COPPER-COVERED - turns GREEN with age (oxidation)! 🟢
Built by thousands of workers over many years! 👷
The main structure has 4 wings representing different aspects of governance! 📐
Beautifully illuminated at night - looks like a GLOWING PALACE! ✨
One of the LARGEST government buildings in India! 📏

coolFacts.text: The ENTIRE BUILDING is constructed with beautiful GRANITE and SANDSTONE! 🪨
The dome took SPECIAL ENGINEERING to construct - a MARVEL of that time! 🏗️
It's a MAJOR LANDMARK visible from many parts of Bangalore! 📍
Thousands of people visit for photography every year! 📸
The building was designed to be FUNCTIONAL and BEAUTIFUL at the same time! 🎨
It symbolizes India's NEW DEMOCRATIC GOVERNMENT after independence! 🇮🇳

didYouKnow.text: Vidhana Soudha means 'Government House' in Kannada! It's not just a building - it's a SYMBOL of democratic governance in India! 🏛️

tryThis.text: Visit Vidhana Soudha at NIGHT when it's illuminated! The lights make it look like a MAGICAL PALACE from a fairy tale! ✨

en.narration:
Vidhana Soudha is the seat of the Karnataka state legislature and government in Bengaluru. 🏛️

Its large Neo-Dravidian design combines traditional Indian architectural elements with modern civic architecture.

kn.title: 🏛️ ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧ - ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಭವ್ಯ ಭವನ!
kn.mainText: ಇದು ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಕಟ್ಟಡಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದೆ. ದ್ರಾವಿಡ ಮತ್ತು ಪಾಶ್ಚಾತ್ಯ ವಾಸ್ತುಶೈಲಿಗಳ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಯಿಂದ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲಾದ ಇದರ ಗುಮ್ಮಟಗಳು ಬಹಳ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ!
kn.narration: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರುದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಟ್ಟಡಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದರ ಭವ್ಯ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ರಾವಿಡ ಶೈಲಿಯ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಇತರ ವಾಸ್ತುಶೈಲಿಗಳ ಪ್ರಭಾವವೂ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ. 🏛️

en.title: 🌊 CHENNAI - The GATEWAY to South India!
en.mainText: Chennai is the capital of Tamil Nadu, a major city on the Bay of Bengal known for classical arts, culture, beaches and Tamil cinema. 🏖️

keyFacts.text: Population: 1 CRORE (10 million)! 🏙️
Called MADRAS before 1996! 🎭
Marina Beach: 13 km LONG! One of the LONGEST beaches! 🏖️
Fort St. George: Historic British fort! 🏛️
San Thome Basilica: 2000-year-old church! ⛪
Kapaleeshwarar Temple: Ancient 400-year-old temple! 🙏
Silk sarees: FAMOUS handmade silk! 🧵
Classical arts: Bharatanatyam dance born here! 💃
Tamil cinema: Kollywood - one of India's major film industries! 🎬
Street food: Dosa, Idli, Sambar! 🍲

coolFacts.text: Chennai is one of the OLDEST cities in India - thousands of years old! 👑
Marina Beach is SO LONG (13 km) that you can walk for HOURS! 🏖️
Fort St. George was built by British in 1644 - 380 years ago! And you can STILL visit it! 🏛️
San Thome Basilica is built over the tomb of Saint Thomas (Doubting Thomas) from JESUS'S DISCIPLES! 2000 years old! ⛪
Tamil cinema produces MORE movies per YEAR than Hollywood! 🎬
Kapaleeshwarar Temple is SO BEAUTIFUL with intricate carvings that it looks like CARVED LACE! 🏛️

didYouKnow.text: Chennai was called 'MADRAS' until 1996 when it was renamed to CHENNAI! The name means 'the gift of Chenna' - a local landlord! 🎁

tryThis.text: Walk along Marina Beach at sunset! Watch the waves crash, feel the sea breeze, and eat FRESH street food! Or visit Kapaleeshwarar Temple and see the intricate carvings! 🏖️

en.narration:
Chennai is the GATEWAY to South India! 🌊

1 CRORE people live here on the coast of the Bay of Bengal! It's a city where ANCIENT TEMPLES meet MODERN BUILDINGS! 🏛️

Marina Beach is INCREDIBLE! 13 km LONG! You can walk for HOURS! 🏖️ The waves crash, the sand is soft, and at sunset the sky turns ORANGE and PINK! 🌅

Fort St. George is a HISTORIC fort built by the British 380 YEARS ago! You can walk inside and feel the HISTORY! 🏛️

But here's the MOST AMAZING part: San Thome Basilica! It's built over the TOMB of Saint Thomas - one of JESUS'S DISCIPLES! That's 2000 YEARS OLD! ⛪

Kapaleeshwarar Temple is SO BEAUTIFUL! 400 years old with INTRICATE CARVINGS! It looks like CARVED LACE! 🙏

Chennai is the HOME OF:
- Bharatanatyam dance 💃
- Silk sarees 🧵
- Classical music 🎵
- Tamil cinema (Kollywood!) 🎬

Tamil cinema makes one of India's major film industries! Over 200 per year! 🎬

When you visit Chennai:
- Walk Marina Beach 🏖️
- Visit Fort St. George 🏛️
- Pray at Kapaleeshwarar Temple 🙏
- Eat AMAZING dosa and idli 🍲
- Feel the HISTORY! 👑

ta.title: 🏛️ சென்னை - பெருமை நகரம்!
ta.mainText: சென்னை தமிழ்நாட்டின் தலைநகரம்! இது கலை, இசை மற்றும் பண்பாட்டின் மையம். கடல் கரை நகரம்.
ta.narration:
சென்னை தமிழ்நாட்டின் பெருமை! இந்தியாவின் மிக பழமையான நகரங்களில் ஒன்று. ஐந்து லட்சம் மக்கள் இங்கு வசிக்கின்றனர்.

சென்னையின் மெரीனா பீச் உலகின் மிகவும் சிறந்த பீச்களில் ஒன்று. கடலுக்கு அருகில் கோவிந்த ராஜ மூர்த்தி பெரிய சிலை உள்ளது।

கபாலீஸ்வரர் கோயில் சென்னையின் மிகவும் பழமையான கோயில். பல்லவ மன்னர்களால் கட்டப்பட்ட இந்த கோயில் அற்புதமாக உள்ளது।

சென்னையில் பல நூல் நிலையங்கள், இசை நிறுவனங்கள், மற்றும் கலை மையங்கள் உள்ளன. பிரபல நர்த்தனமான பரதநாட்டியம் சென்னையிலேயே பிறந்தது।

சென்னை பாரம்பரிய தமிழ் வள்ளல்களின் வாழ்விடம். இங்கு தமிழ் மொழி, சாஸ்திரம் மற்றும் கலாக்களை கற்றுக்கொள்ளலாம்।

en.title: 🗣️ TAMIL - India's Ancient Language!
en.mainText: Tamil is a major classical language of India with a long literary tradition. It is spoken widely in Tamil Nadu and by Tamil communities elsewhere. 🌍

keyFacts.text: Tamil has a long recorded literary tradition, including ancient Sangam literature. 📜 📜
Spoken by 80 MILLION people worldwide! 🌍
One of the 22 official languages of India 🇮🇳
The exact origin of the word 'Tamil' is still debated by language experts today! 🔍
Ancient Tamil has beautiful poetry and literature! 📚
Tamil alphabet has 12 vowels and 18 consonants 🔤
Tamil cinema (Kollywood) makes 200+ movies a year! 🎬
VANAKKAM = Hello/Goodbye 🙏
NANDRI = Thank you 💚
Some Tamil words have been used for 2,000 YEARS without change! ⏰

coolFacts.text: Tamil is the ONLY language with over 2,000 years of continuous literature! 📖
Tamil literature includes love poems, war stories, and ancient wisdom! 💝
Sangam literature (2,000 years old) is the OLDEST Tamil texts! 🏛️
Tamil has influenced many Asian languages! 🌏
Tamil's alphabet is so organized - each letter represents a sound perfectly! 🎯
You can find Tamil in place names everywhere in South India! 🗺️
Tamil cinema is called 'Kollywood' - the K comes from Kodambakkam! 🎥
Tamil words for numbers are SUPER logical - it's like math! 🔢

didYouKnow.text: Tamil is the only language with continuous literary tradition spanning 2,000 YEARS! Other languages changed or disappeared, but Tamil kept going strong! Some ancient Tamil poems are still sung today! 📜

tryThis.text: Learn these cool Tamil words: VANAKKAM (hello), NANDRI (thank you), SAPPADU (food), VELLAI (moon), MANI (jewel). Say them to your friends - you'll sound like a Tamil movie star! 🎬

en.narration:
Tamil is SUPER ancient! Imagine - when the Great Wall of China was being built, Tamil was already written and spoken! 2,000 YEARS! 📜

Tamil is still the same today - you can read Tamil poetry written 2,000 years ago and understand it!

Almost 80 MILLION people speak Tamil - that's like... a whole country! 🌍

Tamil music and movies are FAMOUS all over the world! If you watch Tamil movies (Kollywood), you'll hear beautiful songs and exciting stories! 🎬

The cool part? Every Tamil letter is super organized - each one is like a perfect puzzle piece! 🧩

VANAKKAM (hello), NANDRI (thank you), SAPPADU (food)... try saying them! They sound so cool! 💬

ta.title: 🗣️ தமிழ் - நம் மொழி!
ta.mainText: तमिल तमिलनाडु की प्रमुख भाषा है। यह एक प्राचीन शास्त्रीय भाषा है और इसकी समृद्ध साहित्यिक परंपरा है।
ta.narration:
தமிழ் மொழி ஏழு கோடி மக்களின் மொழி! இது இந்தியாவில் மிகவும் பழமையான மொழிகளில் ஒன்று. தமிழ் இலக்கண மாமணி, சிலப்பதிகாரம், மணிமேகலை - பல மாபெரும் நூல்களை கொண்டுள்ளது।

தமிழ் எழுத்து அவ்வளவு சிற்பமாக உள்ளது! ஒவ்வொரு எழுத்தும் ஒரு கலைத்துண்டு போல் வெளிப்பட்டுள்ளது।

தமிழ் மொழி சங்க இலக்கியத்திற்கு பிரசिद்ध. திருக்குறள், கம்பராமாயணம் தமிழ் மொழிக்கு பெருமை சேர்க்கின்றன।

'வணக்கம்' என்ற சொல் தமிழில் இத்தனை அழகாக உள்ளது! 'நன்றி' என்ற சொல்லின் அர்த்தம் கருணை மற்றும் நன்றி. தமிழ் பிராண்டம் தமிழ் மக்களின் அடையாளம்.

en.title: 🥘 DOSA - The CRISPY, GOLDEN WONDER!
en.mainText: A thin, crispy, golden pancake made from rice and lentils! You dip it in coconut chutney and spicy sambar - ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! 😋

keyFacts.text: Made from rice and lentils fermented overnight! 🍚
Crispy outside, soft inside - PERFECT! ✨
Served with sambar (spicy lentil soup) and coconut chutney 🥥
A dosa takes 2-3 minutes to cook on a hot griddle 🔥
Street food in South India - eaten for breakfast! 🌅
Dosa comes in varieties: Plain, masala (spicy), butter, cheese! 🧀
One dosa = 150-200 calories - good fuel! ⚡
Dosa has been eaten for 1,500+ years! 📜
No dosa is the same - each cook makes it unique! 👨‍🍳
The BEST dosa is hot off the griddle with hot chutney! 🔥

coolFacts.text: A 'Masala Dosa' means the potato filling is spiced - SO GOOD! 🌶️
Some restaurants make GIANT dosas - 2 meters long! Incredible! 📏
The crispy edges are called 'lacy' - like edible lace! 🎀
Sambar (the sauce) has 10+ spices in it - it's a flavor explosion! 💥
Coconut chutney is made fresh every morning - SO fresh! 🥥
Dosa batter needs to ferment - that's the secret to crispiness! ⏰
In South India, dosas are eaten almost every day! 🍽️
You can eat a dosa with your hands - it's like edible cutlery! 🥄

didYouKnow.text: The word 'DOSA' might come from an old Tamil word! It's been part of Tamil culture for THOUSANDS of years! Street vendors have been making dosas the same way for 500+ years! 🌟

tryThis.text: Visit a local South Indian restaurant and try a masala dosa! Dip it in sambar and chutney - the hot, spicy, crispy flavors will blow your mind! 🎉

en.narration:
Dosa is MAGIC! When you bite into a hot dosa, it's crispy on the outside and soft inside - it's like eating a GOLDEN CLOUD! ☁️

Makers pour thin batter on a VERY hot griddle - SSSSSSSSS! It cooks in seconds! 🔥

Then you add the filling - soft potatoes mixed with onions and spices!

The sambar is spicy lentil soup with 10+ spices - your taste buds will DANCE! 💃

And coconut chutney? It's made fresh every morning with FRESH coconut! So creamy and yummy! 🥥

You eat it HOT - straight off the griddle - that's when it's BEST! The crispy edges are like golden lace! ✨

Did you know? People have been making dosas the SAME WAY for over 2,000 years! It's ancient food that's still SUPER popular today! 👨‍🍳

ta.title: 🥘 डोसा!
ta.mainText: डोसा दक्षिण भारत का लोकप्रिय व्यंजन है और तमिलनाडु में भी बहुत पसंद किया जाता है।

en.title: 🏛️ MEENAKSHI TEMPLE - The Golden Goddess's Home!
en.mainText: One of the oldest temples in India with AMAZING golden towers called gopurams! People have worshipped here for 2,600+ years! 🕉️

keyFacts.text: Located in Madurai, Tamil Nadu 📍
Built 2,600 years ago! So ancient! 📜
Golden gopurams (temple towers) reach 170 FEET high! 🏛️
The temple has 14 gopurams - super amazing! 🌟
Thousands of people visit every day! 👥
Goddess Meenakshi = Goddess with fish-shaped eyes! 👀
The temple tank (pond) is HUGE - used for holy baths! 🏊
You'll see intricate carvings everywhere - STUNNING art! 🎨
Festivals here are LOUD and colorful - 🎉
Over 5 million people visit annually! 🌍

coolFacts.text: The gopurams are covered in GOLD and colorful sculptures! ✨
Each sculpture tells a story from Hindu mythology! 📖
The temple has 30,000+ sculptures - can you imagine counting them? 🤔
The 'Hall of 1,000 Pillars' has intricate carvings on EVERY pillar! 🏛️
The temple's architecture influenced temples across South India! 🏗️
During festivals, the streets around the temple are packed with millions of people! 🎊
The temple has its own kitchen feeding 10,000+ people daily during festivals! 🍲
Some parts of the temple are 2,000 years old - UNCHANGED! 🕰️

didYouKnow.text: The Meenakshi Temple is so famous that even ancient travelers wrote about it 2,000 years ago! Roman merchants visited it! The temple has been the spiritual center of Madurai for over 2,600 YEARS! 🌟

tryThis.text: If you visit the Meenakshi Temple, climb up to see the gopurams from different angles - each view is MORE beautiful! Watch the lights at night - MAGICAL! 🌟

en.narration:
The Meenakshi Temple is GORGEOUS! Imagine a place so ancient that your great-great-great grandparents' ancestors visited it! 2,600 YEARS! 📜

The golden gopurams (towers) are so tall - 170 FEET! That's like stacking 50 kids on top of each other! 👦👦👦

Every inch of the temple has BEAUTIFUL carvings and sculptures! The artists spent lifetimes creating them! 🎨

There's a HUGE tank (temple pond) where people take holy baths - it's like an ancient swimming pool! 🏊

Inside, you'll see the 'Hall of 1,000 Pillars' - EVERY pillar has detailed carvings telling stories! 📖

During festivals, over a MILLION people gather here! The colors, the sounds, the smells - it's INCREDIBLE! 🎉

The coolest part? People have been worshipping here for 2,600 YEARS - and it's still BEAUTIFUL and ACTIVE today! 🕉️

ta.title: 🏰 மீனாக்ஷி கோவிל - தமிழின் கோபுரம்!
ta.mainText: மீனாக்ஷி கோவில் மதுரை நகரின் சிறந்ததும் பழமையுமான கோவிலாகும்!

en.title: 🐐 NILGIRI TAHR - Mountain Climber!
en.mainText: The Nilgiri tahr is the state animal of Tamil Nadu and lives in the rocky grasslands of the Western Ghats.

keyFacts.text: Bengal tigers weigh 200-260 kg (400-570 lbs)! 💪
wild tiger numbers are monitored through national wildlife surveys in wild India! 😢
Can jump 30 FEET in a single leap! 🏃
Run at 40 mph - SUPER fast! 🏃‍♂️
Each tiger's stripes are unique - like fingerprints! 🔍
Night hunters - they see in the DARK! 🌙
Can eat 100+ pounds of meat in one meal! 🍖
Live 15 years in wild, 20+ in zoos 📅
Cubs learn to hunt for 2+ years! 👶
Tigers are swimming experts - they love water! 🏊

coolFacts.text: A tiger's roar can be heard 2 MILES away! 📢
Bengal tigers can eat one zebra or buffalo in 4 meals! 🍖
They have night vision 6X better than humans! 👁️
Each tiger's stripe pattern is COMPLETELY unique - no two tigers are the same! 🐯
A tiger can rotate its ears 180 degrees to track sounds! 👂
Tigers are solitary hunters - they hunt alone! 🏕️
They mark their territory by scratching trees and leaving scent marks! 🌳
Tiger cubs wrestle and play to learn hunting skills! 🎮

didYouKnow.text: The Nilgiri tahr is Tamil Nadu's state animal. It lives on steep grassy slopes in the Western Ghats.

tryThis.text: Visit a tiger reserve or zoo and observe tigers carefully. See how they move, hunt, and communicate! Draw your own tiger with unique stripe patterns! 🎨

en.narration: The Nilgiri tahr is Tamil Nadu's state animal. It is a sure-footed mountain ungulate found on steep grassy slopes in the Western Ghats. 🐐

ta.title: 🐐 नीलगिरि तहर!
ta.mainText: नीलगिरि तहर तमिलनाडु का राज्य वन्य पशु है। यह पश्चिमी घाट के ऊँचे घास वाले इलाकों में पाया जाता है।

en.title: 🎉 AMAZING FUN FACTS - Did You Know?
en.mainText: Tamil Nadu is full of CRAZY cool facts! From ancient temples to movie stars to coconut oil - let's explore! 🌟

keyFacts.text: Tamil Nadu has many thousands of temples - MORE temples than any other state! 🕉️
Kollywood (Tamil cinema) makes 200+ movies EVERY YEAR! 🎬
Tamil Nadu produces 80% of India's silk! 🧵
The state has a GIANT monsoon season - Oct to Dec! 🌧️
Chepauk Palace looks like a castle but it's over 250 years old! 🏰
Tamil Nadu has the LONGEST coastline after Gujarat! 🌊
Pearl fishing has been done here for 2,000 years! 💎
The Nilgiri Mountains have a train that's 150+ years old - STILL running! 🚂
Silk production is a HUGE industry - worms spin magic! 🪡
Ancient Tamil scholars invented ZERO in math (maybe)! 🧮

coolFacts.text: Ooty (Nilgiri Hills) is called 'Queen of Hill Stations' - SO beautiful! 👑
The Nilgiri Mountain Railway is one of India's oldest - built in 1873! 🚂
Tamil Nadu exports coconut oil worldwide! 🥥
Thanjavur paintings are SUPER detailed and gorgeous - 300+ years old! 🎨
The state produces 80% of India's spice exports! 🌶️
Some temples in Tamil Nadu have underground tunnels! 🕳️
Tamil Nadu's internet speed is the FASTEST in India! 🚀
The state grows MORE rice than most countries! 🍚

didYouKnow.text: Tamil Nadu has MORE temples (38,000+) than any other Indian state! That's an AVERAGE of 10 temples per town! Plus, Tamil cinema produces one of India's major film industries! 🎬

tryThis.text: Research Tamil Nadu's Thanjavur paintings - they're AMAZING! Or watch a Tamil movie with subtitles and hear the beautiful language! 🎥

en.narration: Tamil Nadu is famous for its ancient temples, classical arts, literature, cinema and long coastline. It is also home to important parts of the Western Ghats and several wildlife habitats. 🌿

ta.title: 🎉 அற்புத தகவல்கள் - தெரியுமா?
ta.mainText: தமிழ்நாடு அற்புதமான தகவல்களால் நிறைந்துள்ளது! பண்டைய கோவில்கள் முதல் திரைப்பட நட்சத்திரங்கள் வரை - கண்டறிவோம்!
ta.narration: தமிழ்நாட்டில் பண்டைய கோவில்கள், திரைப்பட நட்சத்திரங்கள் மற்றும் தேங்காய் எண்ணெய் போன்ற பல அற்புதமான தகவல்கள் உள்ளன!

en.title: 🛕 BRIHADEESWARAR TEMPLE - The Giant Chola Temple!
en.mainText: A MASSIVE 1,000-year-old temple in Thanjavur with a tower so tall and heavy, no one knows exactly how ancient builders raised it!

keyFacts.text: Built around 1010 CE by Chola king Rajaraja I! 📅
Its tower (vimana) stands 66 meters tall! 📏
A UNESCO World Heritage Site! 🌍

coolFacts.text: The huge dome on top is carved from a SINGLE 80-ton block of granite - and nobody is fully sure how it was lifted to the top!
The temple was built entirely without any modern cranes or machines, using ramps and elephants!

didYouKnow.text: The giant dome capping the temple tower weighs about 80 tons and was carved from a single block of granite - historians still debate exactly how ancient builders lifted it 66 meters into the air!

tryThis.text: If you visit, stand at the base and look all the way up at the tower - imagine how it was built without any machines!

en.narration:
In the city of Thanjavur stands one of the greatest achievements of ancient engineering - the Brihadeeswarar Temple! 🛕

Built over 1,000 years ago by the Chola king Rajaraja I, its tower soars 66 meters into the sky.

Here's the truly amazing part - the massive dome on top is carved from a single 80-ton block of granite! Historians still aren't completely sure how ancient builders raised something so heavy without modern cranes.

ta.title: 🛕 பிரகதீசுவரர் கோவில்!
ta.mainText: இது தஞ்சாவூரில் உள்ள 1000 ஆண்டுகள் பழமையான மாபெரும் கோவில்!
ta.narration: இதன் கோபுரம் 66 மீட்டர் உயரம்! மேலே உள்ள பெரிய குவிமாடம் ஒரே கருங்கல் தொகுதியால் செய்யப்பட்டது!

en.title: 🔨 AHMEDABAD - The MANCHESTER of India!
en.mainText: Industrial city! 1 CRORE people! Famous for TEXTILES and DIAMONDS! Modern but respects ancient culture! Where GANDHI lived! 🧵

keyFacts.text: Population: 1 CRORE (10 million)! 🏙️
Called MANCHESTER OF INDIA - textile hub! 🔨
Textiles: Cotton fabrics, dyes, handmade cloth! 🧵
Diamonds: Cut and polished here! 💎
Sabarmati Ashram: Where GANDHI lived! 🙏
Jama Masjid: One of the largest mosques in INDIA! 🕌
Old City: Winding streets, bazaars, HISTORY! 🏘️
Modern: New malls, tech companies! 🏢
Textile museums! 🎨
Street food: Dhokla, Fafda, Jalebi! 🍲

coolFacts.text: Ahmedabad is called MANCHESTER OF INDIA because of all the textile mills! Like England's Manchester! 🔨
Gandhi chose Sabarmati Ashram in Ahmedabad as his HOME! That's where he planned INDEPENDENCE! 🙏
The Jama Masjid is SO HUGE that it can hold 10,000 PEOPLE at once! 🕌
Diamonds from Ahmedabad are sold WORLDWIDE! Beautiful gems cut here! 💎
Old Ahmedabad has NARROW WINDING STREETS! Like walking through a maze! 🌀
Modern Ahmedabad has TECH COMPANIES and STARTUPS! It's GROWING FAST! 🚀

didYouKnow.text: Sabarmati Ashram in Ahmedabad is where GANDHI lived and worked! It's a SACRED place for Indian independence! 🙏

tryThis.text: Visit Sabarmati Ashram to see where Gandhi lived! Or explore the Old City bazaars! Eat dhokla and jalebi from street vendors! 🍲

en.narration:
Ahmedabad is where INDUSTRY meets SPIRITUALITY! 🔨

1 CRORE people live in this bustling city! It's called the MANCHESTER OF INDIA because of all the TEXTILE MILLS! 🧵

The Sabarmati Ashram is WHERE GANDHI LIVED! This is where he PLANNED INDIA'S INDEPENDENCE! 🙏 It's a SACRED place!

The Jama Masjid is MASSIVE! Can hold 10,000 people at once! SO BEAUTIFUL! 🕌

Old Ahmedabad is a MAZE of NARROW WINDING STREETS! Bazaars full of COLORS, SOUNDS, SMELLS! 🌀

Modern Ahmedabad has TECH COMPANIES, STARTUPS, and PROGRESS! It's EVOLVING FAST! 🚀

When you visit:
- See Gandhi's Ashram 🙏
- Explore Old City bazaars 🏘️
- Visit Jama Masjid 🕌
- Eat dhokla and jalebi 🍲
- Feel the HISTORY and ENERGY! ⚡

gu.title: 🏛️ अहमदाबाद - व्यापार का शहर!
gu.mainText: अहमदाबाद गुजरात का एक प्रमुख शहर है और व्यापार, उद्योग, शिक्षा तथा संस्कृति का महत्वपूर्ण केंद्र है।
gu.narration:
અમદાવાદ ગુજરાતનું હૃદય છે! આ શહેર ખૂબ જ જીવંત અને ગતિશીલ છે. દરેક વીથીમાં દુકાનો અને ફેક્ટરીઓ છે જ્યાં કપડા, હીરા, ઝીણાશાહી કામ બધું બનાવવામાં આવે છે.

સાબરમતી નદી શહેરને બે ભાગમાં વહેતી છે. મહાત્મા ગાંધીજીનું સાબરમતી આશ્રમ અહીં છે જ્યાં તેમણે ભારતીય સ્વતંત્રતાના ખ્વાબ જોયા હતા.

શહેરમાં પ્રાચીન સિધી સૈયદ માસ્જીદ, કાળી માતાનું મંદિર અને આધુનિક કોર્પોરેટ બિલ્ડિંગ બધું દેખાય છે. રાત્રે જ્યારે સાબરમતી રિવરફ્રન્ટ પર રોશનીઓ લાગે છે, ત્યારે શહેર સ્વર્ગ લાગે છે.

હોલી અમદાવાદમાં ખૂબ જ રંગીન હોય છે. દરેક ઘર સૌજન્ય અને પ્રેમથી ભરપૂર હોય છે. અમદાવાદનું આતમા વ્યાપાર, કલા અને સંસ્કૃતિમાં નિહિત છે.

en.title: 🗣️ GUJARATI - The Musical Language!
en.mainText: Spoken by 60 million people! Gujarati sounds musical and flows like water - it's SO beautiful to listen to! 🎵

keyFacts.text: Gujarati has 36 consonants and 12 vowels! 🔤
Spoken by 60 MILLION people worldwide! 🌍
It's the language of Mahatma Gandhi! 🕯️
GUJARATI = GUJARA LAND + I = Language of Gujarat Land! 💬
Uses Gujarati script which is similar to Hindi script! ✍️
NAMASTE = Hello 🙏
ABHAR = Thank you 💚
Gujarati music and songs are FAMOUS! 🎶
The language has been written for 1,000+ years! 📜
Many successful business people speak Gujarati! 💼

coolFacts.text: Gujarati is the language of India's business hub! 💰
Mahatma Gandhi spoke Gujarati - he's the father of independent India! 🕯️
Gujarati cinema (Gujarati movies) is growing super fast! 🎬
The script is so organized - each letter follows a pattern! 🎯
Gujarati has beautiful folk songs called 'Garba' songs! 💃
Many Indian entrepreneurs and business leaders speak Gujarati! 📈
The language borrowed words from Persian, Arabic, and English! 🌏
Gujarati greeting 'SHUVO' means good/auspicious! ✨

didYouKnow.text: Mahatma Gandhi spoke Gujarati! He led India's independence movement and changed the WORLD! Many successful business people you know speak Gujarati! It's the language of innovation! 🌟

tryThis.text: Learn Gujarati greetings: NAMASTE (hello), ABHAR (thank you), KHANA (food), PANI (water), KHUSI (happiness). Teach your friends - you'll sound super cool! 🎤

en.narration:
Gujarati is the language of BUSINESS and INNOVATION! 💼

60 MILLION people speak Gujarati around the world! That's like... a whole continent's population! 🌍

It sounds SO musical - almost like singing when you speak it! 🎵

Mahatma Gandhi spoke Gujarati! He's the guy who led India to independence and changed the WORLD! 🕯️

Gujarati business people have created HUGE companies all over the world! 💰

The language has 36 consonants and 12 vowels - it's super organized like a perfect puzzle! 🧩

Vocabulary is BEAUTIFUL - 'KHUSI' means happiness and joy! 😊

There are amazing Gujarati movies, songs, and stories! 🎬

NAMASTEE, ABHAR! (Hello, Thank you!) You're speaking Gujarati now! 🙏

gu.title: 🗣️ ગુજરાતી - આપણી ભાષા!
gu.mainText: गुजराती गुजरात की प्रमुख भाषा है और इसे गुजराती लिपि में लिखा जाता है।
gu.narration:
ગુજરાતી ભાષા ૬ કરોડ લોકોની પ્રિય ભાષા છે! તે ગુજરાતમાં, પાકિસ્તાન, અમેરિકા, કેનેડા અને ઓસ્ટ્રેલિયામાં બોલાય છે.

ગુજરાતી લેખન અત્યંત સુંદર છે - દરેક અક્ષર એક કલાત્મક ચિત્ર જેવો લાગે છે. ભાષાનું નામ 'ગુજર' (લોકો) અને 'આત' (ભાષા) શબ્દોથી આવે છે.

ગુજરાતીમાં મોહનદાસ કરમચંદ ગાંધી, ધર્મશીલ કવિ, અને અસંખ્ય વિદ્વાનોએ લેખન કર્યું છે. આ ભાષાનો સાહિત્ય અમૃત જેવો છે.

'નમસ્તે' આ ભાષામાં ખૂબ જ સુંદર છે. 'આનંદ' એ ગુજરાતી શબ્દ દરેક હૃદયે પ્રવેશ કરે છે. આ ભાષા વ્યાપાર, કલા અને ધર્ম બધુ મેળ આપે છે.

હાલમાં ગુજરાતી વૈશ્વિક ભાષા બની રહી છે. દરેક દેશમાં ગુજરાતી સ્કુલ, મંદિર અને સમાજો છે. આ ભાષા આપણી જતનની જવાબદારી છે.

en.title: 🍴 DHOKLA - The FLUFFY, STEAMY WONDER!
en.mainText: A light, fluffy, sweet cake made from lentils and rice! It's steamed (not fried) so it's nutritious! 🥘

keyFacts.text: Made from fermented rice and lentil batter! 🍚
Steamed in a large flat pan - SO fluffy! ☁️
Only 100 calories - super light meal! 🏃
Topped with mustard seeds, green chili, and coconut! 🥥
Takes 15 minutes to steam - fast! ⏰
Breakfast or snack - eaten EVERYWHERE in Gujarat! 🌅
Can be sweet or savory - both taste AMAZING! 😋
Stays fresh for 3-4 days! 📅
nutritious - protein + carbs! 💪
Each family has their own special recipe! 👨‍🍳

coolFacts.text: The steaming creates bubbles inside - making it fluffy like a sponge! 🧽
Khichiyu (sweet dhokla) tastes like sweet bread - SO good! 🍮
Some dhoklas are fried - called 'fafda' - CRISPY and DELICIOUS! 🍟
The fermentation process creates natural probiotics - GOOD for your tummy! 💚
You can add vegetables to dhokla batter - peas, carrots, corn! 🥕
A single dhokla can be torn and eaten - it's SO fluffy! 🤏
Street vendors sell dhoklas stacked in towers - beautiful presentation! 🏢
Dhokla pairs PERFECTLY with fresh fruit juice! 🥤

didYouKnow.text: Dhokla has been eaten in Gujarat for HUNDREDS of years! It's mentioned in ancient Gujarati texts! Even today, it's THE most popular breakfast in Gujarat! Street vendors wake up at 4 AM to make it fresh! 🌅

tryThis.text: Try making dhokla at home! It's so easy - mix batter, steam, and eat! Top it with mustard seeds, chili, and coconut. YUM! 🍳

en.narration:
Dhokla is FLUFFY, LIGHT, and YUMMY! ☁️

It looks like a golden sponge cake but it's NOT sweet - it's savory and amazing! 🥘

Makers take fermented rice and lentil batter, add ginger, chili, and spices, then steam it in BIG flat pans! 🍲

When it steams, it puffs up like a cloud! ☁️

Then you cut it into squares and top it with mustard seeds that CRACKLE and pop when you eat it! 🎆

It's SO healthy - only 100 calories! Perfect for active kids! 💪

Gujaratis eat dhokla for breakfast almost EVERY day! Street vendors sell it fresh in the morning! 🌅

You can eat it plain, with chutney, with pickles, or with yogurt!

The BEST part? It takes only 15 minutes to make - faster than most breakfasts! ⏰

Try it - your taste buds will LOVE the combination of fluffy texture and spicy flavor! 🌟

gu.title: 🍲 ધોકલો - ગુજરાતનું નાસ્તો!
gu.mainText: ધોકલો ગુજરાતનો સૌથી પ્રખ્યાત અને સ્વાદવાળો નાસ્તો છે!

en.title: 🕌 STATUE OF UNITY - world's TALLEST Statue!
en.mainText: A COLOSSAL 182-meter tall statue of Vallabhbhai Patel! It's the TALLEST statue in the ENTIRE WORLD! 🌟

keyFacts.text: Located in Narmada Valley, Gujarat 📍
182 meters tall - SUPER SUPER tall! 🏛️
Built to honor Vallabhbhai Patel (Iron Man of India) 💪
Took 5 years to build! 👷
Bronze, limestone, and concrete - 2,000+ workers! 🔧
Has museum and galleries inside! 🎨
You can ride elevator to the chest - 150 meters high! 🛗
Visitors can see 3-4 km in all directions! 👁️
Built for $430 MILLION - one of world's most expensive statues! 💰
Over 1 million visitors per year! 👥

coolFacts.text: It's 33 meters TALLER than Statue of Liberty! 🗽
The statue weighs 68,000 tons - SUPER HEAVY! ⚖️
The face itself is 14 meters wide - you can see emotions! 😊
Elevated walkways let you walk INSIDE the statue! 🚶
Museum shows Patel's life story with holograms! 🔮
Laser light show at night - SPECTACULAR! 💡
The statue overlooks the Narmada River - beautiful views! 🌊
It's a symbol of Indian unity and strength! 🇮🇳

didYouKnow.text: Vallabhbhai Patel was the 'Iron Man of India' who united all of India's princely states! He's like the Avengers leader who brought everyone together! The statue honors his incredible achievement! 💪

tryThis.text: Visit the Statue of Unity and take the elevator inside! See the 360-degree view from the chest area - it's MIND-BLOWING! Take photos from different angles! 📸

en.narration:
The Statue of UNITY is ABSOLUTELY MASSIVE! 🌟
