182 METERS TALL! That's like stacking a 20-story building on TOP of another 20-story building! 🏢🏢

It's the TALLEST statue in the ENTIRE WORLD! Taller than Statue of Liberty, taller than Christ the Redeemer in Brazil!

Who is it? Vallabhbhai Patel - called the 'Iron Man of India'! He united all of India's princely states after independence! 💪

Inside, there are elevators and galleries! You can ride UP 150 meters and see OUT from the statue's CHEST! 🛗

The view? You can see 3-4 kilometers in ALL directions! It's like looking from a helicopter! 👁️

At NIGHT, it has laser light shows - SPECTACULAR and MAGICAL! 💡

The statue is made of bronze, limestone, and concrete - 2,000+ workers built it over 5 YEARS! 👷

It cost $430 MILLION - one of the world's most expensive statues! 💰

Over 1 MILLION people visit every year to see this wonder! 👥

It's a symbol of India's STRENGTH and UNITY! 🇮🇳

gu.title: 🏗️ स्टैच्यू ऑफ यूनिटी!
gu.mainText: स्टैच्यू ऑफ यूनिटी सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल की विशाल प्रतिमा है। यह गुजरात के केवड़िया क्षेत्र में स्थित है।
gu.narration: સર્દાર વલ્લભ પટેલ ભારતનો લોખંડ મુરુધર હતો!

en.title: 🦁 ASIATIC LION - The Majestic King!
en.mainText: The world's only wild population of Asiatic lions is found in and around Gir in Gujarat. They're Asiatic lions are endangered and are protected through conservation efforts in and around Gir. 🙏

keyFacts.text: Only 600-700 Asiatic lions left in the world! 😢
Live only in Gir Forest National Park, Gujarat 📍
Weigh 160-190 kg (350-420 lbs) - HUGE! 💪
Males have MAGNIFICENT manes! 👑
Can live 15-20 years in wild 📅
Hunt in prides (groups) - cooperative hunters! 👨‍👩‍👦
Roar can be heard 9 km away! 📢
Cubs spend 2-3 years learning to hunt 👶
Eat 7-10 kg meat per day - BIG appetite! 🍖
about a century ago, fewer than 20 Asiatic lions left! 😢

coolFacts.text: Asiatic lions have smaller manes than African lions! 👑
They have a FOLD of skin on their belly - unique feature! 🐱
Prides are smaller than African lion prides - 3-10 lions! 👥
Female lions (lionesses) do most of the hunting! 💪
Cubs play-fight to learn hunting skills! 🎮
Project Lion in Gir Forest has successfully increased their numbers! 📈
Tourists can visit Gir Forest and see these MAJESTIC lions! 🚙
Asiatic lions roar to mark territory and communicate! 📢

didYouKnow.text: about a century ago, there were FEWER than 20 Asiatic lions left in the entire world! Now there are 600-700! This is one of the biggest conservation SUCCESSES! Scientists worked super hard to bring them back! 🙏

tryThis.text: Learn about Project Lion - the conservation effort that saved Asiatic lions! Visit Gir Forest (if possible) and see these AMAZING animals in their natural habitat! 🦁

en.narration:
Asiatic lions are ABSOLUTELY MAJESTIC! 👑

BUT - they're SUPER ENDANGERED! Only 600-700 left in the ENTIRE WORLD! 😢

They live ONLY in Gir Forest in Gujarat! That's the ONLY place where wild Asiatic lions exist!

They're HUGE - weigh 350-420 pounds! That's like 4-5 kids combined! 💪

Males have BEAUTIFUL manes - but smaller than African lions! 👑

Here's the cool part - lionesses (female lions) do the HUNTING! They work as a team! 💪

Their roar? You can hear it from 9 km away! That's like hearing a shout from 3 school blocks away! 📢

BUT here's the AMAZING part - about a century ago, fewer than 20 existed! Scientists saved them! Now there are 600+ through Project Lion! 🙏

They're making a COMEBACK! 📈

Visit Gir Forest and see these ROYAL animals! 🦁

gu.title: 🦁 એશિયાતિક સિંહ - ગીર રણનો રાજા!
gu.mainText: એશિયાતિક સિંહ ગીર જંગલમાં જીવે છે!
gu.narration: એશિયાતિક સિંહ ગુજરાતનો રાજ પશુ છે!

en.title: 🎉 AMAZING FUN FACTS - Gujarat Rocks!
en.mainText: Gujarat is a land of CONTRAST - deserts, oceans, business, and ancient history all mixed together! 🌟

keyFacts.text: Gujarat is India's BUSINESS HUB - 23% of India's GDP! 💰
The state produces salt from salt pans - TONS of it! 🧂
Rann of Kutch is HUGE white salt desert! ❄️
Mahatma Gandhi's birthplace Porbandar is in Gujarat! 🕯️
Gujarat makes 80% of India's diamonds! 💎
The Asiatic lion lives ONLY in Gir Forest here! 🦁
Cotton production - Gujarat is THE hub! 🧵
Ahmedabad is called 'Manchester of India'! 🏭
The state has AMAZING textile markets! 🛍️
Gujarati people are FAMOUS business people worldwide! 💼

coolFacts.text: Rann of Kutch is one of the world's largest salt marshes! 🏜️
During Rann Utsav (festival), the white desert looks like SNOW! ❄️
Ahmedabad has ancient step wells called 'baolis' - architectural MARVELS! 🕳️
Gujarat produces textiles that are exported worldwide! 🌍
The state is called 'Jewel of India' for its resources! 💎
Textile dyeing and printing is an ART here! 🎨
Gujarati traders traveled to Africa, Arabia, and Europe! 🚢
The state's entrepreneurial spirit is LEGENDARY! 🚀

didYouKnow.text: Gujarat is an important centre for industry, trade, agriculture and renewable energy, with a long coastline and the Rann of Kutch. 💼

tryThis.text: Research Gujarati entrepreneurs who became billionaires! Learn about their journeys from small businesses to MASSIVE companies! You could be next! 🚀

en.narration: Gujarat is known for its diverse geography and economy, from the Rann of Kutch and long Arabian Sea coastline to major industrial and trading centres. 🌟

gu.title: 🎉 અદ્ભુત તથ્યો - ગુજરાત જબરદસ્ત છે!
gu.mainText: ગુજરાત વિરોધાભાસની ભૂમિ છે - રણ, સમુદ્ર, વેપાર અને પ્રાચીન ઇતિહાસ બધું એકસાથે!
gu.narration: ગુજરાતમાં રણ પણ છે, સમુદ્ર કિનારો પણ છે, મોટા વેપારી શહેરો પણ છે અને હજારો વર્ષ જૂનો ઇતિહાસ પણ છે - આ બધું એક જ રાજ્યમાં!

en.title: 🙏 SOMNATH TEMPLE - The Temple of the Moon God!
en.mainText: One of India's 12 MOST SACRED temples! An ANCIENT temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, beautifully rebuilt after centuries of invasions!

keyFacts.text: One of the 12 JYOTIRLINGAS - most sacred shrines in Hinduism! 🙏
Located by the Arabian Sea - SO BEAUTIFUL! 🌊
First temple built in 649 CE - over 1350 YEARS OLD! 👵
Rebuilt 17 TIMES after invasions - a symbol of RESILIENCE! 💪
The current temple was rebuilt in 1951 after independence! 🇮🇳
The temple tower is 155 feet tall - MAGNIFICENTLY TALL! 📏
Made with intricate STONE CARVINGS - BEAUTIFUL CRAFTSMANSHIP! 🎨
Attracts over 10 LAKH pilgrims annually! 🙏

coolFacts.text: The name 'Somnath' means 'Lord of the Moon' - dedicated to Chandra (Moon God)! 🌙
The temple has SURVIVED multiple INVASIONS and EARTHQUAKES - a TRUE SURVIVOR! 💪
The sunken temple chamber is unique to Somnath - ARCHITECTURAL MARVEL! 🏛️
A famous saying: 'Somnath is never destroyed' - because it keeps getting REBUILT! ✨
The temple faces the Arabian Sea - unique positioning for a temple! 🌅
Inside, ancient STONE IDOLS are CAREFULLY PRESERVED! 🗿

didYouKnow.text: Somnath Temple is a SYMBOL of RESILIENCE and FAITH! It has been destroyed and rebuilt SO MANY TIMES that it represents the INDOMITABLE SPIRIT of India! 💪

tryThis.text: Visit Somnath Temple during SUNSET by the Arabian Sea - the VIEW is ABSOLUTELY MAGICAL! 🌅

en.narration:
SOMNATH TEMPLE is a SYMBOL of FAITH and RESILIENCE! 🙏

Located ON THE SEASHORE of the Arabian Sea, it's ONE OF THE 12 MOST SACRED TEMPLES IN HINDUISM! 🌊

Over 1350 YEARS OLD! Built in 649 CE - that's before the MIDDLE AGES in Europe! 👵

But here's the AMAZING part: It was DESTROYED and REBUILT 17 TIMES! After invasions, earthquakes, and disasters, the people ALWAYS rebuilt it! 💪

Even after COMPLETE DESTRUCTION, they said: 'Somnath is never destroyed!' - NEVER GIVE UP attitude! ✨

The CURRENT temple was rebuilt in 1951, right after India became independent! It's a SYMBOL of India's REVIVAL! 🇮🇳

The temple tower is 155 FEET TALL with INTRICATE STONE CARVINGS! Every detail is CAREFULLY CARVED! 🎨

Inside, you feel the SPIRITUAL ENERGY! MILLIONS of pilgrims have prayed here over 1350 YEARS! 🙏

The SUNSET VIEW here is ABSOLUTELY SPECTACULAR! The sun sinking into the Arabian Sea while the temple glows - it's MAGICAL! 🌅

gu.title: 🙏 સોમનાથ મંદિર - ભગવાન શિવનું પવિત્ર મંદિર!
gu.mainText: સોમનાથ મંદિર ગુજરાતના પ્રભાસ પાટણમાં આવેલું ભગવાન શિવને સમર્પિત પ્રસિદ્ધ મંદિર છે. તેનું અનેક વખત પુનઃનિર્માણ થયું છે.
gu.narration: સોમનાથ મંદિર ગુજરાતના દરિયાકિનારા નજીક આવેલું એક મહત્વનું તીર્થસ્થળ છે. ભગવાન શિવને સમર્પિત આ મંદિરનો લાંબો અને રસપ્રદ ઇતિહાસ છે. 🙏

en.title: 🕌 HYDERABAD - The CITY OF PEARLS!
en.mainText: Home of PEARLS! Tech city! 1 CRORE people! Charminar = 400-year-old monument! AMAZING biryani! 🍲

keyFacts.text: Population: 1 CRORE (10 million)! 🏙️
Called CITY OF PEARLS - pearls grown here! 💎
Charminar is more than 400 years old and dates to 1591. 🕌
Tech hub: Google, Microsoft, Facebook offices! 💻
Biryani: BEST in India! 🍲
Hussain Sagar Lake: HUGE lake in city center! 🌊
Old City bazaars: Narrow streets, spices, colors! 🎨
Ramoji Film City: Bollywood studios! 🎬
Snow Foam: A 4-story foam structure - cool! ❄️
Falaknuma Palace: Stunning palace! 👑

coolFacts.text: Charminar was built 400 years ago (1591) and STILL stands! It has 4 towers (char = 4, minar = tower)! 🕌
Hyderabad was FAMOUS for pearls - traders came from around the world! Now pearls are rare! 💎
The city is built in a valley between two lakes - Hussain Sagar and Mula-Mutha! 🌊
Hyderabad's biryani is SO FAMOUS that people say it's the BEST in the entire world! 🍲
Tech companies have THOUSANDS of employees here! It's a tech powerhouse! 💻
Ramoji Film City is the world's LARGEST film studio - movies are made here! 🎬

didYouKnow.text: Hyderabad's Charminar is SO ICONIC that it's the symbol of the entire city! Every postcard has it! 🕌

tryThis.text: Try authentic Hyderabadi biryani! Visit Charminar and explore the old city bazaars! Or take a boat ride on Hussain Sagar Lake! 🍲

en.narration:
Hyderabad is the CITY OF PEARLS! 💎

1 CRORE people live here on beautiful lakes! It's a city where HISTORY and TECHNOLOGY meet! 🏙️

The Charminar is the HEART of Hyderabad! Built 400 years ago (1591)! It has 4 towers - 'char' means 4, 'minar' means tower! 🕌

Hyderabad was FAMOUS throughout the world for its PEARLS! Traders came from everywhere to buy them! 💎

Now it's a TECH HUB! Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Amazon - all have HUGE offices here! Thousands of tech workers code, design, and build apps! 💻

But the BEST part? The BIRYANI! 🍲 Hyderabadi biryani is considered the BEST in the entire world! Rice cooked with meat, spices, and... MAGIC! People travel from other countries just to eat it!

Hussain Sagar is a MASSIVE lake right in the middle of the city! You can take boat rides! 🌊

When you visit Hyderabad:
- See Charminar 🕌
- Explore old bazaars (narrow streets full of colors!) 🎨
- Eat authentic biryani 🍲
- Ride boats on Hussain Sagar 🌊
- Feel the HISTORY! 👑

te.title: 🏛️ హైదరాబాద్ - చార్మినార్ నగరం!
te.mainText: హైదరాబాద్ సరస్సులు మరియు చారిత్రిక గుర్తింపుల చుట్టూ ఉన్న నగరం!

en.title: 🗣️ TELUGU - The Melodious Language!
en.mainText: Telugu is sometimes popularly described as musical because of its sound and literary tradition. 🎵 Over 75 million people speak it! 🎵

keyFacts.text: Spoken by millions people! 🌍
Called 'a language with a rich literary tradition' - super melodious! 🎵
One of the oldest Dravidian languages! 📜
Exact origin of the word 'Telugu' is debated by scholars - some link it to the ancient 'Trilinga' region! 🔍
Has beautiful curved script that looks like waves! 🌊
NAMASKARAM = Hello! 🙏
DHANYAVADAM = Thank you! 💚
Telugu cinema (Tollywood) is HUGE - many films yearly! 🎬
Ancient Telugu literature dates back 1,000+ years! 📚
Famous worldwide through Telugu movies and actors! 🌟

coolFacts.text: Telugu is the one of the major languages spoken in the region in India! 🏆
Tollywood (Telugu cinema) is the second-largest film industry after Hindi! 🎬
Telugu script is so artistic - each letter looks like a piece of art! 🎨
The language has beautiful poetry called 'Padyalu'! 📖
Telugu actors are SUPER famous in Indian cinema! ⭐
The language borrowed from Sanskrit and influenced other languages! 🌍
Some Telugu words have deep spiritual meaning! 🙏
Famous Telugu celebrities work in Hindi cinema too! 🌟

didYouKnow.text: Telugu is one of India's major languages and is spoken widely in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Tollywood produces almost 100 movies EVERY YEAR! 🎬

tryThis.text: Watch Telugu movies with subtitles! Or learn Telugu greetings: NAMASKARAM (hello), DHANYAVADAM (thank you), ROJULLO (good day)! 🎥

en.narration:
Telugu is SUPER musical! It's called 'a language with a rich literary tradition' - imagine talking and singing at the same time! 🎵

millions people speak Telugu! That's like... the entire population of Egypt! 🌍

Tollywood (Telugu cinema) is HUGE - many films EVERY YEAR! That's almost 2 movies per week! 🎬

The script is SO beautiful - it looks like waves and curves! 🌊

Telugu has been written for over 1,000 YEARS! Ancient poets wrote beautiful verses called 'Padyalu'! 📖

Vocabulary is SO poetic - some words have meanings that go super deep! 🙏

Telugu actors are WORLD FAMOUS! They act in Hindi movies too!

NAMASKARAM (Nah-mas-KAR-um) = Hello! DHANYAVADAM (Dhan-ya-VAH-dum) = Thank you!

Say these words and you're speaking one of world's famous languages! 🌟

te.title: 🗣️ తెలుగు - దక్షిణ భారతు ధ్వని!
te.mainText: तेलुगु तेलंगाना की प्रमुख भाषा है और यह द्रविड़ भाषा परिवार से संबंधित है।

en.title: 🍲 HYDERABADI BIRYANI - The Royal Rice Treasure!
en.mainText: A LEGENDARY rice dish with meat and spices layered together! Each grain of rice is infused with flavor! It's the KING of Indian rice dishes! 👑

keyFacts.text: Biryani means 'cooked together' - rice + meat cooked together! 🍚
Hyderabadi biryani is THE BEST in India! 👑
Invented for royal kings (Nizams) of Hyderabad! 👑
Takes 45-60 minutes to cook! ⏰
Uses basmati rice - long and fragrant! 🌾
Cooked in layers - marinated meat, then rice! 🍽️
Saffron (expensive spice) gives it golden color! 🟡
Each grain is separate - never mushy! ✨
Served with raita (yogurt) and pickles! 🥒
One of world's most famous Indian dishes! 🌍

coolFacts.text: Biryani was invented for Mughal emperors! 👑
The word 'Biryani' comes from Persian! 🌏
Dum pukht (slow cooking) is the SECRET! ⏱️
Saffron and rose water give it fragrance! 🌹
Different regions make biryani differently - Hyderabadi is best! 🏆
A single biryani pot feeds 4-5 people easily! 👥
The rice never gets mushy - each grain is PERFECT! ✨
Biryani can be made with chicken, mutton, or vegetables! 🥘

didYouKnow.text: Hyderabadi biryani developed in the Hyderabad region and is strongly associated with the city's culinary history and Nizami-era cuisine.! Kings ate it at royal feasts! 👑

tryThis.text: Visit a authentic Hyderabadi biryani restaurant and order a proper biryani! Eat it with raita and pickles! Or watch videos of biryani-making! 🎥

en.narration:
Hyderabadi biryani is ABSOLUTELY LEGENDARY! 👑

Imagine - long golden rice grains mixed with tender meat, all fragrant with saffron and spices!

It was invented for the NIZAMS (kings) of Hyderabad! This is ROYAL FOOD! 👑

Cooks layer marinated meat and rice in a big pot - then seal it! 🔒

Slow cooking (called 'dum pukht') - the flavors mix together perfectly!

When you open the lid - WOW! Golden rice, aromatic steam, AMAZING smell! 🌟

Each grain of rice is SEPARATE - not mushy! That's the art of making biryani! ✨

Saffron (the most expensive spice!) gives it golden color and special fragrance! 🌹

You eat it with yogurt (raita) and pickles - the flavors are MIND-BLOWING! 🤯

One pot of biryani feeds a WHOLE family!

It's so famous that UNESCO recognizes it as part of world's cultural heritage! 🌍

Hyderabadi biryani is the BEST biryani in the ENTIRE WORLD! 👑

te.title: 🍲 బిర్యానీ - రాజ్యభోజనం!
te.mainText: బిర్యానీ సుగంధ రైస్ మసాలలు మరియు మాంసం సహా ఉడికిన!

en.title: 🕌 CHARMINAR - Four-Faced Beauty!
en.mainText: A historic monument built in 1591 with four grand arches. It's the most iconic building in Hyderabad! 🌟

keyFacts.text: Built in 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah! 📜
156 feet tall - SUPER impressive! 🏛️
Four arches on four sides - one for each direction! 🧭
Each arch is 21.3 meters high! 🎯
Named after Charminar (4 minarets)! ✨
Used as a watchtower historically! 👀
Over 4 million visitors annually! 👥
Surrounded by busy marketplace - action everywhere! 🛍️
Part of UNESCO World Heritage Site area! 🌍
Symbol of Hyderabad's identity! 🏛️

coolFacts.text: Built to commemorate the founding of Hyderabad! 🎉
The architect designed it in Persian style! 🌏
Each arch has beautiful stucco work - ART! 🎨
The tower was used to call people to prayer! 📯
Built with granite core and lime mortar! 🏗️
From top, you can see the whole old city! 👁️
The marketplace around it is 400 YEARS OLD! 🏪
Charminar appears in Indian currency design! 💵

didYouKnow.text: Charminar is so famous that it appears on Indian currency! It's the symbol of Hyderabad's 400-year history! Millions of people visit every year! It's an icon of India's architectural heritage! 🌟

tryThis.text: Visit Charminar early morning to avoid crowds! Climb to the top and see 360-degree views of Hyderabad! Shop at the bazaar around it for traditional items! 🛍️

en.narration:
Charminar is ABSOLUTELY BEAUTIFUL! 🌟

4-FACED beauty - 'Char' means 4 in Hindi, 'Minar' means tower!

It's 156 FEET TALL - built 400 YEARS AGO! 📜

When you stand under Charminar and look UP - it's BREATHTAKING! 😍

Four massive arches - one facing each direction! North, South, East, West! 🧭

Each arch is 21.3 meters high - like stacking 7 tall adults! 📏

Built in Persian architectural style - SO elegant! 🌏

Inside, there's a marketplace that's been ACTIVE for 400 YEARS! People are buying, selling, eating, shopping - organized CHAOS! 🛍️

Climb to the top and see ENTIRE old city of Hyderabad! 👁️

From the top, you can see how the city grew around Charminar!

It's so important that it appears on INDIAN CURRENCY! 💵

Over 4 MILLION people visit every year! 👥

Charminar is the HEART and SOUL of Hyderabad! 💓

te.title: 🕌 చార్మినార్ - నాలుగు మినార్ల అందం!
te.mainText: 1591లో నిర్మించబడిన ఈ చారిత్రక కట్టడానికి నాలుగు గొప్ప కమానాలు ఉన్నాయి. ఇది హైదరాబాద్‌కు ఎంతో ప్రసిద్ధమైన గుర్తు! 🌟
te.narration: హైదరాబాద్‌ పాత నగరంలో ఉన్న చార్మినార్‌ను 1591లో నిర్మించారు. నాలుగు మినార్లు మరియు అందమైన కమానాలతో ఇది నగరానికి ప్రసిద్ధ చిహ్నంగా నిలిచింది. 🕌

en.title: 🐘 ASIAN ELEPHANT - Gentle Giant!
en.mainText: The Asian elephant is the largest land animal in Asia and can weigh several tonnes. 🐘 Super intelligent, emotional, and social! 💪

keyFacts.text: Asian elephants weigh 4-5 TONS! 💪
Largest land animal in Asia! 🏆
Can live 40-50 years in wild! 📅
Trunk has 40,000+ muscles! 💪
Ears are HUGE - like fans! 👂
Incredibly intelligent - can solve puzzles! 🧩
Family-oriented - live in herds! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
Communicate through rumbling sounds! 📢
Only 3 species of wild elephants left! 😢
Memory is LEGENDARY - never forget! 🧠

coolFacts.text: Trunk is like a super hand - 40,000+ muscles! 💪
Can pick up a pea or knock down a tree! 🌳
Asian elephants have smaller ears than African elephants! 👂
They're vegetarian - eat 200+ kg food daily! 🥗
Babies (calves) are called 'umbrellas' - adorable! 👶
Elephants mourn their dead - VERY emotional! 💔
Live in family groups led by oldest female! 👵
Play in mud - it's like sunscreen for them! 🏊

didYouKnow.text: Asian elephants are ENDANGERED! Only 40,000-50,000 left in wild! They're losing habitat because forests are disappearing! Many sanctuaries are trying to save them! 😢

tryThis.text: Visit an elephant sanctuary and observe elephants! See how they interact with family members! Support elephant conservation! 🐘

en.narration:
Asian elephants are ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! 🐘

They're HUGE - 5-6 TONS! That's like 10 cars combined! 💪

Their trunk? 40,000+ muscles! It can pick up a tiny pea OR knock down a TREE! 🌳

They're SO intelligent - they solve puzzles, use tools, and remember things for YEARS!

Elephants are EMOTIONAL! They cry, celebrate, and mourn their dead! 💔

They live in family groups - mothers, daughters, sisters together! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

Communicate through RUMBLING sounds - like underground telephone! 📢

Babies are SO CUTE - called 'calves' - they follow moms everywhere! 👶

Elephants love water and mud! They spray mud like sunscreen! 🏊

BUT - they're ENDANGERED! Only 40,000-50,000 left! 😢

Forests are disappearing and elephants lose homes! We NEED to save them! 🌳

Support elephant sanctuaries! 🐘

te.title: 🐘 ఏనుగు!
te.mainText: చిత్తల జింక తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర జంతువు. ఇది అడవులు మరియు గడ్డి భూముల్లో కనిపిస్తుంది.

en.title: 🎉 AMAZING FUN FACTS - Telangana Treasures!
en.mainText: Telangana is newest Indian state (formed 2014) but has ANCIENT history! Biryani, Charminar, and pearls - it's SPECIAL! 🌟

keyFacts.text: Telangana became a separate state in 2014! 🎉
Famous worldwide for Hyderabadi biryani! 🍲
Pearl capital of India - produces TONS of pearls! 💎
Charminar is symbol of Hyderabad! 🕌
Home to IT industry - tech hub! 💻
Hyderabad is called 'Cyber City'! 🏙️
Ancient kingdom ruled by Nizams (kings)! 👑
Home to Ramoji Film City - Bollywood set! 🎬
Produces 90% of India's diamonds! 💎
Miracles Bazaar - one of India's oldest markets! 🛍️

coolFacts.text: Hyderabad doubled in population in 20 years! 📈
Miracles Bazaar has been operating for 400+ years! 🏪
Telangana has 1,500+ ancient temples! 🕉️
Pearl processing happens here - world famous! 💎
Tech companies like Microsoft, Google have offices here! 💼
Ramoji Film City is HUGE - bigger than many cities! 🎥
Tanks (ponds) dot the landscape - ancient water system! 💧
Biryani Festival happens annually - HUGE celebration! 🎉

didYouKnow.text: Hyderabad became India's 'Silicon Valley' - tons of tech companies! It went from a historical city to a MODERN TECH HUB in 20 years! 💻🌟

tryThis.text: Watch Ramoji Film City - it's like visiting a movie studio! Or visit Pearl Street to see traditional pearl trading! 🎥💎

en.narration:
Telangana is a MIX of old and new! 🌟

It's the NEWEST Indian state - only became separate in 2014! 🎉

BUT - it has THOUSANDS of years of history!

Hyderabad is now called 'Cyber City' - TONS of tech companies! 💻

Microsoft, Google, Amazon - all have offices here!

Biryani - WORLD FAMOUS! Charminar - 400 years old! 🕌

Pearl capital - produces 90% of India's diamonds AND pearls! 💎

Ramoji Film City - where Indian movies are made! It's MASSIVE! 🎬

MiraWalking through 400-year-old bazaars where people still trade pearls!

Ancient temples everywhere - 1,500+ temples in Telangana!

Hyderabad went from historical kingdom to TECH HUB in just 20 years!

Telangana shows how India blends HISTORY with MODERN INNOVATION! 🌟

te.title: 💎 కోహినూర్ వజ్రం!
te.mainText: कोहिनूर हीरा गोलकुंडा क्षेत्र से जुड़ा हुआ माना जाता है। इसका इतिहास कई शताब्दियों और अलग-अलग शासकों से जुड़ा है।

en.title: 🏰 GOLCONDA FORT - The Diamond Fortress!
en.mainText: A massive hilltop fort where FAMOUS DIAMONDS like the Kohinoor were once stored and traded!

keyFacts.text: Built over 200 years by the Qutb Shahi dynasty! 🏗️
Famous for the Golconda diamond mines nearby! 💎
Has a clap at the entrance you can hear from the top of the hill! 👏

coolFacts.text: Clap at the base gate and the sound echoes all the way up to the top - it was used as an alarm system!
The fort's water supply system used a Persian wheel to lift water 200 feet up the hill!

didYouKnow.text: Some of the most famous diamonds in the world - including the legendary Kohinoor - passed through Golconda's markets before traveling across the globe!

tryThis.text: If you visit, clap your hands at the entrance gate and listen for the echo at the top of the hill!

en.narration:
Golconda Fort sits on a granite hill, guarding the old city of Hyderabad! 🏰

It was built by the Qutb Shahi kings over 200 years, growing bigger and stronger with each ruler.

The fort is famous for one very sparkly reason - DIAMONDS! Nearby mines produced incredible diamonds, and Golconda became the market where they were bought and sold. Some diamonds from here became world-famous!

Here's the coolest part: if you clap your hands at the entrance gate, the sound echoes and can be heard by guards all the way at the top of the hill! It was basically an ancient alarm system! 👏

Engineers also built a clever water system using a Persian wheel to lift water 200 feet up to the top of the fort - no electricity needed!

te.title: 🏰 గోల్కొండ కోట!
te.mainText: గోల్కొండ కోటలో ప్రసిద్ధ వజ్రాలు నిల్వ చేసేవారు!
te.narration: గోల్కొండ కోట హైదరాబాద్‌లోని ఒక పెద్ద కొండ కోట! ఇక్కడి ద్వారం వద్ద చప్పట్లు కొడితే, శబ్దం కొండ పైకి వినిపిస్తుంది!

en.title: 🏛️ AMARAVATI - The New Capital!
en.mainText: A brand-new planned city on the banks of the Krishna River! Andhra Pradesh's capital is Amaravati - built almost from scratch!

keyFacts.text: Capital: Amaravati, on the Krishna River! 🌊
Amaravati is being built as a brand-new 'greenfield' city! 🏗️
Andhra Pradesh's old capital was Hyderabad - lost after Telangana split off in 2014! 🏙️

coolFacts.text: Amaravati was an ancient Buddhist city - home to a famous stupa built 2,000 years ago!
The new Amaravati is designed to be a 'smart city' with green spaces and modern buildings!

didYouKnow.text: The Krishna River is called the 'Ganges of South India' because it's so important to the region!

tryThis.text: Find Amaravati on a map and see how close it is to the Krishna River!

en.narration: Amaravati is the capital of Andhra Pradesh, built on the Krishna River...

te.title: 🏛️ అమరావతి - పవిత్ర నగరం!
te.mainText: కృష్ణ నదీ ఒడ్డున ఉన్న ఒక నగరాన్ని ఊహించుకోండి! అమరావతి అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రాజధాని మరియు ఇది అందమైన ఆలయాలు మరియు ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాధాన్యత కోసం ప్రసిద్ధి చెందింది.

keyFacts.text: రాజధాని: అమరావతి, కృష్ణ నది ఒడ్డున! 🌊
అమరావతి ఒక సర్వే నిర్మాణమైన 'గ్రీన్‌ఫీల్డ్' నగరం! 🏗️
అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ యొక్క పాత రాజధాని హైదరాబాద్ - 2014లో తెలంగాణ వేరు అయిన తర్వాత కోల్పోయింది! 🏙️

coolFacts.text: అమరావతి ఒక పురాతన బౌద్ధ నగరం - 2,000 సంవత్సరాల క్రితం నిర్మించిన ప్రసిద్ధ స్తూపకు నిబాసం!
కొత్త అమరావతి ఒక 'స్మార్ట్ సిటీ'గా రూపొందించబడింది, ఆకుపచ్చ ప్రదేశాలు మరియు ఆధునిక భవనాలతో!

didYouKnow.text: కృష్ణ నదిని 'దక్షిణ భారతం యొక్క గంగ' అని అంటారు ఎందుకంటే ఇది ప్రాంతానికి చాలా ముఖ్యమైనది!

tryThis.text: మ్యాప్‌లో అమరావతిని కనుగొని, అది కృష్ణ నదికి ఎంత దగ్గరగా ఉందో చూడండి!

te.narration: అమరావతి అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రాజధాని, కృష్ణ నది ఒడ్డున నిర్మితమైనది...

en.title: 🗣️ TELUGU - A Language of Poets!
en.mainText: Imagine 80 million people speaking the same language! Telugu is one of the oldest languages in the world, and it's written with beautiful curved letters.

keyFacts.text: 80 million speakers worldwide - that's almost the whole population of Germany! 🌍
One of the oldest and most developed languages in the world! 📚
Official language of Andhra Pradesh! 🎭

coolFacts.text: Telugu has one of the richest literary traditions in India, with poems and stories going back 1,500 years!
Telugu movies are famous all over the world - they're sometimes called 'Tollywood'!

didYouKnow.text: Written in beautiful curved script that looks like little dances! 💃

tryThis.text: Learn to say 'Namaste' in Telugu: 'Namaskaram'!

en.narration: Telugu is the language of Andhra Pradesh! Imagine 80 million people speaking the same language...

te.title: 🗣️ తెలుగు - కవుల భాష!
te.mainText: तेलुगु आंध्र प्रदेश की प्रमुख भाषा है। यह द्रविड़ भाषा परिवार की एक प्रमुख भाषा है और इसकी समृद्ध साहित्यिक परंपरा है।

keyFacts.text: ప్రపంచవ్యాపీ 80 మిలియన్ మంది మాట్లాడతారు - ఇది జర్మనీ మొత్తం జనాభాకు సమానం! 🌍
ప్రపంచంలోని అతిపురాతన మరియు అత్యంత అభివృద్ధి చెందిన భాషలలో ఒకటి! 📚
అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ అధికారిక భాష! 🎭

coolFacts.text: తెలుగు భారతంలో అత్యంత సమృద్ధమైన సాహిత్య ఐతిహ్యం కలిగి ఉంది, కవితలు మరియు కథలు 1,500 సంవత్సరాలు వెనుకకు పోతాయి!
తెలుగు సినిమాలు ప్రపంచం అంతటా ప్రసిద్ధి - అవి కొన్నిసార్లు 'టాలీవుడ్'గా పిలవబడతాయి!

didYouKnow.text: చిన్న నృత్యాల వలె కనిపించే సుందర వక్ర లిపిలో వ్రాయబడుతుంది! 💃

tryThis.text: తెలుగులో 'నమస్కారం' చెప్పడం నేర్చుకోండి!

te.narration: తెలుగు అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ భాష! 80 మిలియన్ మంది ఒకే భాషను మాట్లాడుతున్నారని ఊహించుకోండి...

en.title: 🍛 GONGURA CURRY - Tangy and Tasty!
en.mainText: Gongura is a favorite curry of Andhra Pradesh! It's tangy, spicy, and absolutely delicious. Made with sorrel leaves and special spices, it's a festival favorite!

keyFacts.text: Made with sorrel leaves (gongura pala)! 🌿
Tangy taste that makes your taste buds dance! 😋
Perfect with rice and served at celebrations! 🍚

coolFacts.text: Sorrel leaves are also called 'gongura pala' in Telugu and are full of vitamins!
Gongura curry is not just food - it's part of Andhra Pradesh family traditions!

didYouKnow.text: Gongura leaves grow wild in many parts of India, but Andhra Pradesh has perfected the recipe!

tryThis.text: Try making gongura curry at home with an adult's help!

en.narration: Gongura is the taste of Andhra Pradesh! Imagine mixing tangy sorrel leaves with rice...

te.title: 🍛 గుంగూర కూర - తీపి జాదూ!
te.mainText: గుంగూర కూర అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ నుండి ఒక ప్రియమైన కూర! ఇది ఖట్టా, మసాలాదైనది, మరియు చాలా రుచికరమైనది. సాలమిర్చి ఆకులు మరియు ప్రత్యేక మసాలాలతో తయారు చేయబడింది, ఇది పండుగ ప్రియమైనది!

keyFacts.text: సాలమిర్చి ఆకులతో (గుంగూర పాల)! 🌿
మీ రుచి కలుపులను నృత్యం చేయటానికి ఖట్టా రుచి! 😋
అన్నతో సంపూర్ణమైనది మరియు సంబరాలలో పరివేషించబడుతుంది! 🍚

coolFacts.text: సాలమిర్చి ఆకులను తెలుగులో 'గుంగూర పాల' అని అంటారు మరియు విటమిన్‌లతో నిండిఉన్నాయి!
గుంగూర కూర కేవలం ఆహారం కాదు - ఇది అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ కుటుంబ సంప్రదాయాలలో భాగం!

didYouKnow.text: సాలమిర్చి ఆకులు భారతం యొక్క చాలా భాగాలలో కారు పెరుగుతాయి, కానీ అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రెసిపీని పరిపూర్ణం చేసింది!

tryThis.text: ఒక పెద్దవారి సహాయంతో ఇంట్లో గుంగూర కూర చేయడానికి ప్రయత్నించండి!

te.narration: గుంగూర కూర అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ యొక్క రుచి! ఖట్టా సాలమిర్చి ఆకులను అన్నతో కలపడం ఎలా ఉంటుందో ఊహించుకోండి...

en.title: 🛕 TIRUPATI TEMPLE - Wonder on a Mountain!
en.mainText: Tirupati Temple is one of the most visited temples in India! Built on a beautiful mountain, pilgrims climb 3,500 steps to reach the sacred Sri Venkateswara Temple. It's a place of faith and wonder!

keyFacts.text: It's famous! 💰
3,500 steps to climb! 🏔️
Millions of pilgrims visit every year! 👥

coolFacts.text: Built over 1,000 years ago!
The temple has beautiful wood carvings and sculptures that are centuries old!

didYouKnow.text: Tirupati Temple is one of the richest temples in the entire world!

tryThis.text: Find Tirupati on a map and imagine climbing 3,500 steps up a mountain!

en.narration: Welcome to Tirupati Temple - a place where earth touches the sky...

te.title: 🛕 తిరుమల ఆలయం - పర్వతంపై అద్భుతం!
te.mainText: తిరుమల ఆలయం భారతం యొక్క అత్యంత సందర్శించిన ఆలయాలలో ఒకటి! ఒక అందమైన పర్వతంపై నిర్మితమైన, తీర్థ దర్శకులు పవిత్ర శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర ఆలయానికి చేరుకోవటానికి 3,500 సోపానాలు ఎక్కుతారు. ఇది విశ్వాస మరియు అద్భుత స్థానం!

keyFacts.text: ఇది ప్రసిద్ధి! 💰
ఎక్కవలసిన 3,500 సోపానాలు! 🏔️
ప్రతి సంవత్సరం మిలియన్ల మంది తీర్థ దర్శకులు సందర్శిస్తారు! 👥

coolFacts.text: 1,000 సంవత్సరాల క్రితం నిర్మితమైనది!
ఆలయంలో సుందర చెక్క చెక్కకలలు మరియు శిల్పాలు ఉన్నాయి, అవి శతాబ్దాల పురాతనమైనవి!

didYouKnow.text: తిరుమల ఆలయం ఇది మొత్తం ప్రపంచంలోని సమృద్ధమైన ఆలయాలలో ఒకటి!

tryThis.text: మ్యాప్‌లో తిరుమలిని కనుగొని, పర్వతం పైకి 3,500 సోపానాలు ఎక్కడం ఎలా ఉంటుందో ఊహించుకోండి!

te.narration: తిరుమల ఆలయానికి స్వాగతం - ఒక స్థానం ఇక్కడ భూమి ఆకాశాన్ని తాకుతుంది...

en.title: 🦌 BLACKBUCK - The Graceful Dancer!
en.mainText: The blackbuck is the state animal of Andhra Pradesh.

keyFacts.text: It's a beautiful antelope! 🌀
Can run super fast! 💨
Andhra Pradesh's state animal! 🏆

coolFacts.text: Blackbucks are incredibly graceful - they jump and leap with perfect balance, like dancers!
The Blackbuck's horns spiral up to 4 feet long - they look like beautiful twisted sculptures!

didYouKnow.text: Long ago, kings hunted Blackbucks for sport, but now they're protected because very few are left.

tryThis.text: Draw a picture of a Blackbuck showing its beautiful spiral horns!

en.narration: Meet the Blackbuck - Andhra Pradesh's superstar animal! Picture a beautiful antelope...

te.title: 🦌 కృష్ణమృగం - అందమైన నర్తకుడు!
te.mainText: కృష్ణమృగం అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రాష్ట్ర జంతువు! ఇది సర్పిలాకార కొమ్ములు కలిగిన అందమైన జింక, మరియు ఇది సూపర్ ఫాస్ట్ పరిగెత్తగలదు. ఈ చలువగా ఉండే జంతువులు ఇప్పుడు రక్షించబడుతున్నాయి ఎందుకంటే అవి చాలా ఎక్కువ వేటకు గురయ్యాయి.

keyFacts.text: ఇది అందమైన జింక! 🌀
సూపర్ ఫాస్ట్ పరిగెత్తగలదు! 💨
అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రాష్ట్ర జంతువు! 🏆

coolFacts.text: కృష్ణమృగాలు చాలా చలువగా ఉంటాయి - అవి కదుపుతూ, నృత్యం చేస్తున్నట్లు దిక్కుతాయి!
కృష్ణమృగం యొక్క కొమ్ములు 4 ఫీట్ వరకు పెరుగుతాయి - అవి సుందర చిక్కబడిన శిల్పాల్లా కనిపిస్తాయి!

didYouKnow.text: చాలా రోజుల క్రితం, రాజులు ఆటకు కృష్ణమృగాలను వేటు చేశారు, కానీ ఇప్పుడు వారు రక్షించబడతారు ఎందుకంటే చాలా తక్కువ మంది మిగిలిఉన్నారు.

tryThis.text: కృష్ణమృగం యొక్క సుందర సర్పిలాకార కొమ్ములను చూపించే చిత్రాన్ని గీయండి!

te.narration: కృష్ణమృగం - అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ సూపర్ స్టార్ జంతువుతో పరిచయం చేసుకోండి! అందమైన జింకను చిత్రించుకోండి...

en.title: 🌶️ CHILLI CHAMPIONS!
en.mainText: Andhra Pradesh produces the hottest chillies in India! The red chillies grown here are sent all over the world for cooking. It's called the 'Chilli Bowl of India'!

keyFacts.text: Grows spicy chillies! 🌶️
They're sent all over the world! 🌍
Guntur city is the chilli capital! 🔥

coolFacts.text: Andhra Pradesh exports chillies to more than 50 countries around the world!
They're used in food from India to Mexico to China - they travel the world!

didYouKnow.text: Andhra Pradesh produces a major chilli-growing region in India - that's a LOT of spicy food!

tryThis.text: Research where the chillies from your kitchen come from - they might be from Andhra Pradesh!

en.narration: Did you know? Andhra Pradesh is the chilli champion of India! The red chillies grown here...

te.title: 🌶️ మిర్చి చాంపియన్‌లు!
te.mainText: आंध्र प्रदेश भारत के प्रमुख मिर्च उत्पादक क्षेत्रों में से एक है। गुंटूर क्षेत्र मिर्च की खेती और व्यापार के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

keyFacts.text: మిర్చిలను ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తుంది! 🌶️
ప్రపంచం చుట్టూ పంపబడతాయి! 🌍
గుంటూర్ నగరం మిర్చి రాజధానీ! 🔥

coolFacts.text: అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ప్రపంచం చుట్టూ 50+ దేశాలకు మిర్చిలను ఎగుమతి చేస్తుంది!
భారతం నుండి మెక్సికో నుండి చైనా నుండి వంటకులలో ఉపయోగిస్తారు - అవి ప్రపంచం ఎక్కుముకుంటాయి!

didYouKnow.text: అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ భారతం యొక్క సుమారు 30% మిర్చిలను ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తుంది - ఇది చాలా విపరీతమైన ఆహారం!

tryThis.text: మీ వంటగదిలోని మిర్చిలు ఎక్కడ నుండి వస్తాయో పరిశోధించండి - అవి అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ నుండి ఉండవచ్చు!

te.narration: మీకు తెలుసా? అంధ్రప్రదేశ్ భారత మిర్చి చాంపియన్! ఇక్కడ ఉత్పత్తి చేయిన ఎర్ర మిర్చిలు...

en.title: 🛕 TIRUMALA - Sri Venkateswara Temple
en.mainText: Tirumala in Andhra Pradesh is home to the famous Sri Venkateswara Temple, one of India’s important pilgrimage sites.

keyFacts.text: Built in 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah! 🏗️
Has 4 MAGNIFICENT MINARETS - each 56 meters tall! 📏
The name 'Charminar' means 'Four Towers' in Persian! 🏛️
Located in the old city of Hyderabad - heart of HISTORY! 🏙️
One of the oldest MOSQUES in India - still functional! 🕌
Built as a monument to mark the end of a plague! ⚕️
The arches and balconies are BEAUTIFULLY DECORATED! 🎨
Over 500 YEARS OLD - a LIVING MONUMENT to history! 👵

coolFacts.text: The 4 minarets are NOT identical - each has UNIQUE FEATURES! 🔍
From the TOP, you can see the ENTIRE OLD CITY of Hyderabad! 📍
It's made of GRANITE and LIMESTONE - weathered to GOLDEN COLOR! 🪨
There's a BAZAAR underneath the monument - still active after 400 years! 🛍️
The calls to prayer from Charminar are BROADCAST LIVE - heard across Hyderabad! 📻
It's one of the most PHOTOGRAPHED MONUMENTS in India! 📸

didYouKnow.text: The Sri Venkateswara Temple is located on the Tirumala hills near Tirupati and attracts pilgrims throughout the year.

tryThis.text: Climb to the TOP of Charminar and enjoy the 360-DEGREE VIEW of Hyderabad! Absolutely SPECTACULAR! 🌅

en.narration: Tirumala is a hill town in Andhra Pradesh known for the Sri Venkateswara Temple. Pilgrims visit the temple throughout the year, and the surrounding hills are part of the Eastern Ghats.

te.title: 🛕 తిరుమల - శ్రీ వేంకటేశ్వర స్వామి ఆలయం
te.mainText: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్‌లోని తిరుమల ప్రసిద్ధ శ్రీ వేంకటేశ్వర స్వామి ఆలయానికి నిలయం. ఇది భారతదేశంలోని ముఖ్యమైన పుణ్యక్షేత్రాలలో ఒకటి.
te.narration: తిరుమల ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్‌లోని ప్రసిద్ధ పర్వత ప్రాంతం. ఇక్కడి శ్రీ వేంకటేశ్వర స్వామి ఆలయాన్ని ఏడాది పొడవునా అనేక మంది భక్తులు సందర్శిస్తారు.

en.title: 🏛️ LUCKNOW - City of NAWABS!
en.mainText: Home of Taj Mahal (in Agra)! 2.3 CRORE people! Ancient capital! Mughal palaces! Delicious kebabs! 🍖

keyFacts.text: Population: more than 200 million people (230 million)! 🌍
Contains Taj Mahal in Agra - one of 7 wonders! 🏰
Capital: Lucknow - City of Nawabs! 👑
Chikhalwari: Beautiful handicrafts! 🎨
Food: Kebabs, biryanis, AMAZING cuisine! 🍖
Varanasi: Holy city on Ganga river! 🙏
Uttar Pradesh is INDIA'S MOST POPULOUS state - 1 in 6 Indians lives here! 🌍
Ancient kingdoms: Ayodhya, Mathura - holy cities! 🙏
Crafts: Chikhalwari embroidery! 🧵
Lucknow Biryani: DIFFERENT from Hyderabadi! 🍲

coolFacts.text: Taj Mahal is one of the 7 WONDERS OF THE WORLD! It's in Agra, Uttar Pradesh! ✨
Uttar Pradesh is SO POPULOUS that if it were a country, it would be the 3rd most populated in the WORLD! 🌍
Lucknow was the capital of the Mughal empire - HOME to emperors and nawabs! 👑
Varanasi is the HOLIEST city in India - people come from all over the world! 🙏
The Lucknow Biryani is DIFFERENT from Hyderabadi - it uses more meat and less spices! 🍲
Uttar Pradesh has some of the OLDEST cities in the world - Ayodhya, Mathura! 👑

didYouKnow.text: Uttar Pradesh is the MOST POPULOUS state in India - more than 200 million people people live here! That's more than the population of many countries! 🌍

tryThis.text: Visit Taj Mahal in Agra - one of the famous buildings in the world! Or explore Varanasi - the holiest city! 🏰

en.narration: Lucknow is the capital of Uttar Pradesh and is known for its Nawabi-era architecture, literature, crafts and cuisine. Agra, home of the Taj Mahal, is a different city in the same state. 🏛️

hi.title: 🏛️ लखनऊ - नवाबों का शहर!
hi.mainText: लखनऊ एक खूबसूरत शहर है!

en.title: 🗣️ HINDI - An Official Language of the Union!
en.mainText: Hindi is widely spoken in Uttar Pradesh and is one of India's major languages. 🇮🇳

keyFacts.text: Hindi spoken by 90+ MILLION in UP! 🌍
Official language of India! 🇮🇳
Originated in North India - UP region! 🏠
HINDI = HIN + DI = Language of India! 💬
Sanskrit ancestry - ancient root! 📜
NAMASTE = Hello/Goodbye 🙏
SHUKRIYA = Thank you 💚
hundreds of millions speakers worldwide! 🌏
Written in Devanagari script - like mountains! ⛰️
Bollywood movies are mostly in Hindi! 🎬

coolFacts.text: Hindi is more ancient than modern English! 📜
hundreds of millions speakers - world's 4th most spoken! 🏆
Devanagari script connects like a continuous line! 📝
Hindi borrowed from Persian, Arabic, Sanskrit! 🌍
Bollywood movies spread Hindi worldwide! 🎬
Hindi literature - 1,000+ years old poetry! 📖
Tongue twisters in Hindi are SUPER fun! 😄
No capital letters - all equal! ✨

didYouKnow.text: Hindi is an official language of the Union for official purposes; India has no official language of the Union for official purposes. Uttar Pradesh is where Hindi ORIGINATED! Over hundreds of millions people speak Hindi worldwide - that's almost 10% of EARTH'S POPULATION! 🌟

tryThis.text: Learn Hindi! Bollywood movies are mostly in Hindi - watch with subtitles! Make Hindi friends! Teach others Hindi words! 🎬

en.narration: Hindi is widely spoken in Uttar Pradesh. Hindi is an official language of the Union for official purposes, while India has no official language of the Union for official purposes. 🗣️

hi.title: 🗣️ हिंदी!
hi.mainText: हिंदी यूपी में बोली जाती है!

en.title: 🍴 SAMOSA - The CRISPY Triangular Treasure!
en.mainText: A LEGENDARY crispy triangle filled with spiced potatoes and peas! It's India's MOST popular street food! 🥔

keyFacts.text: Originated in Uttar Pradesh! 📍
Crispy pastry shell - deep fried! 🔥
Filled with potatoes, peas, spices! 🥔
Served with chutney - mint or tamarind! 🌿
One samosa = 150-200 calories! ⚡
Quick meal - sold everywhere! 🛣️
Can have meat or vegetarian filling! 🥘
Dough needs kneading for crispiness! 👨‍🍳
Street vendors sell 1000s daily! 👥
Mentioned in 13th century texts! 📜

coolFacts.text: Samosa shape is PERFECT for holding! 🔺
Vegetable filling gives it texture! 🥕
Mint chutney is THE perfect pair! 🌿
Some samosas have coconut, raisins! 🥥
Can be baked instead of fried - healthier! 🍽️
Every region has different samosa style! 🗺️
Street vendors are samosa ARTISTS! 👨‍🍳
Samosa + chai = PERFECT combo! ☕

didYouKnow.text: Samosa has been made for over a long culinary history! It's mentioned in medieval Indian texts! It's the widely enjoyed Indian snack! Over very large numbers samosas are eaten annually in India! 🌟

tryThis.text: Eat a samosa from a street vendor - authentic experience! Make samosas at home with parents! Try different chutneys! 🍳

en.narration: Samosa is a popular snack in India, usually made from a crisp pastry filled with spiced ingredients such as potato and peas. It has a long history and many regional variations. 🥔

hi.title: 🍴 समोसा!
hi.mainText: समोसा भारत में बहुत लोकप्रिय नाश्ता है। उत्तर प्रदेश में भी इसे चटनी के साथ खूब पसंद किया जाता है।

en.title: 🕌 TAJ MAHAL - A UNESCO World Heritage Monument!
en.mainText: The Taj Mahal in Agra is a 17th-century marble mausoleum commissioned by Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal.

keyFacts.text: Located in Agra, Uttar Pradesh 📍
Built 1632-1653 - Emperor Shah Jahan! 👑
A tomb for wife Mumtaz Mahal! 💕
Made of white marble - SO beautiful! 🤍
Inlay work with semi-precious stones! 💎
UNESCO World Heritage Site! 🌍
7 million+ visitors annually! 👥
Symmetrical design - PERFECT architecture! 📐
Gardens, mosque, water channels - complete complex! 🏛️
One of world's 7 wonders! 🌟

coolFacts.text: Built by 20,000+ workers over many years! 👷
White marble glows different colors at different times! 🌅
Inlay work uses jade, crystal, turquoise! 💎
Dome is perfect semicircle - architectural genius! 🏛️
Minarets lean OUTWARD to protect main building! 🏯
Calligraphy from Quran covers walls! 📜
Gardens were REVOLUTIONARY - Mughal gardening! 🌳
Cost: equivalent of BILLION dollars today! 💰

didYouKnow.text: Taj Mahal was built because Shah Jahan wanted to build an ETERNAL MONUMENT to his wife's love! He spent many years and BILLIONS building it! It's proof that LOVE creates MASTERPIECES! 💕

tryThis.text: Visit Taj Mahal - see it at sunrise, midday, and sunset! Each time, it looks different! Walk through gardens! Experience the architecture! 📸

en.narration: The Taj Mahal in Agra is a 17th-century marble mausoleum commissioned by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. 🕌

hi.title: 🕌 ताज महल - यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्मारक!
hi.mainText: आगरा का ताज महल 17वीं सदी का संगमरमर का मकबरा है, जिसे शाहजहाँ ने मुमताज़ महल की याद में बनवाया था।
hi.narration: आगरा में यमुना नदी के किनारे ताज महल स्थित है। शाहजहाँ ने इसे मुमताज़ महल की स्मृति में बनवाया था। सफेद संगमरमर और सुंदर नक्काशी इसकी खास पहचान हैं। 🕌

en.title: 🦌 BARASINGHA - Swamp Deer!
en.mainText: The barasingha, or swamp deer, is the state animal of Uttar Pradesh.

keyFacts.text: Bengal tigers weigh 200-260 kg! 💪
Only 3,000 left in India! 😢
Can jump 30 FEET in one leap! 🏃
Run at 40 mph - SUPER fast! 🏃‍♂️
Each stripe pattern is unique - fingerprint! 🔍
Nocturnal hunters - hunt at night! 🌙
Eat 100+ lbs meat in one meal! 🍖
Live 15 years in wild! 📅
Cubs learn hunting 2+ years! 👶
Swimming experts - LOVE water! 🏊

coolFacts.text: Roar heard 2 miles away! 📢
Night vision 6X better than humans! 👁️
Each tiger's stripes COMPLETELY unique! 🐯
Ears rotate 180 degrees - hunt by sound! 👂
Solitary hunters - hunt alone! 🏕️
Mark territory with scratches and scent! 🌳
Cubs wrestle to learn hunting! 🎮
Stripe patterns unchanged from ancient times! ⏰

didYouKnow.text: The barasingha, or swamp deer, is Uttar Pradesh's state animal. It is a conservation success story in parts of northern India.

tryThis.text: Visit tiger reserves in UP! Spot tigers if lucky! Support Project Tiger conservation! Draw tigers with unique patterns! 🎨

en.narration: The barasingha, or swamp deer, is Uttar Pradesh's state animal. Conservation programmes have helped protect this distinctive deer in northern India. 🦌

hi.title: 🦌 बारहसिंगा!
hi.mainText: बारहसिंगा उत्तर प्रदेश का राज्य वन्य पशु है। यह अपने बड़े, शाखाओं वाले सींगों के लिए जाना जाता है।

en.title: 🎉 AMAZING FUN FACTS - Uttar Pradesh Greatness!
en.mainText: Uttar Pradesh is INDIA'S HEARTLAND! Taj Mahal, Varanasi, ancient history, Bollywood influence! 🌟

keyFacts.text: Population: 230+ MILLION - more than most countries! 👥
Taj Mahal - world's famous building! 🕌
Varanasi - one of the oldest continuously inhabited city! 🏛️
Birthplace of Buddha (Sarnath)! 🙏
Birthplace of Ram (Ayodhya)! 🕉️
Agra Fort - massive red fortress! 🏰
Krishna Land - birthplace of Lord Krishna! 🪮
Bollywood connection - many actors from UP! 🎬
Ganges River - world's holiest river! 🌊
Historical capitals: Agra, Lucknow! 👑

coolFacts.text: UP population = 5th largest country! 👥
Varanasi has 10,000+ temples! 🕉️
Agra Fort has 70+ rooms! 🏰
Ganges carries pilgrims' wishes! 🌊
Lucknow is 'City of Nawabs' - royal heritage! 👑

en.narration:
Near Agra stands one of history's biggest 'what ifs' - Fatehpur Sikri! 🕌

Emperor Akbar built this entire red sandstone city in 1571, filled with palaces, courtyards, and the world's tallest gateway, the Buland Darwaza, standing 54 meters high.

But here's the twist - after only about 15 years, everyone left, probably because the city ran out of water! Today, the empty but beautifully preserved buildings feel frozen in time.

en.narration:
Towering over Delhi is the Qutub Minar - a giant brick minaret that has stood for over 800 years! 🗼

It's 73 meters tall, made from red sandstone and marble, with beautiful carvings winding all the way around it. 379 steps spiral up to the top!

Nearby stands something even more mysterious - an iron pillar that hasn't rusted in over 1,600 years! Scientists are still amazed by how ancient builders made metal that strong.

The Qutub Minar has survived earthquakes, lightning strikes, and centuries of weather - and it's still one of the most famous towers in the world!

বাংলা লিপি অত্যন্ত সুন্দর - প্রতিটি অক্ষর একটি শিল্পকর্ম। ভাষাটি অত্যন্ত মনোমুগ্ধকর এবং সাবলীল।

'নমস্কার' বাংলায় বলা অত্যন্ত মার্জিত। 'ধন্যবাদ' মানে কৃতজ্ঞতা এবং সেবা। বাংলা ভাষায় প্রেম, সহানুভূতি এবং সৌন্দর্য বোঝা যায়।

বাংলা সাহিত্য শতাব্দী ধরে বিকশিত হয়েছে। রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর এই ভাষায় নোবেল পুরস্কার জিতেছেন।

বাংলা ভাষা বাঙালি জাতির আত্মা। এটি শিক্ষা, শিল্প এবং প্রজ্ঞার প্রতীক। বাংলা আমাদের পরিচয়।

en.title: 🏛️ VICTORIA MEMORIAL - The White Marble Palace!
en.mainText: One of INDIA'S famous monuments! A MASSIVE white marble building dedicated to Queen Victoria!

keyFacts.text: Built between 1906-1921 to honor Queen Victoria! 👑
Made ENTIRELY of WHITE MARBLE - GLOWING and BEAUTIFUL! 💎
Designed by British architect William Emerson in Indo-Saracenic style! 🏗️
The main dome is topped with a BRONZE STATUE of Victoria - ICONIC! 👑
Set in beautiful gardens with fountains and ponds! 🌳
Over 73 meters tall - as tall as a 15-story building! 📏
One of the MOST VISITED MONUMENTS in India - over 2 million visitors annually! ✈️
UNESCO World Heritage site - recognized as WORLD CLASS! 🏆

coolFacts.text: The white marble was imported from MAKRANA in Rajasthan - same marble as Taj Mahal! 💎
The monument has a MUSEUM inside with over 30 galleries! 🏛️
The internal decorations include Italian marble, Belgian glass, and Burmese teak! ✨
It took 15 YEARS and thousands of workers to build! ⏳
The NIGHT ILLUMINATION makes it look like a GLOWING GHOST! 👻
It was commissioned when Queen Victoria was already DEAD - built as a MEMORIAL! 🕯️

didYouKnow.text: Victoria Memorial is one of the FINEST EXAMPLES of Indo-Saracenic ARCHITECTURE! It perfectly blends British and Indian architectural styles! 🏛️

tryThis.text: Visit Victoria Memorial at SUNSET! The marble glows ORANGE and PINK - absolutely BREATHTAKING! 🌅

en.narration:
VICTORIA MEMORIAL is KOLKATA'S MOST STUNNING MONUMENT! 🏛️

When you first see it, your BREATH STOPS! It's SO WHITE, SO PURE, SO MAGNIFICENT! 💎

Made ENTIRELY of WHITE MARBLE from Makrana (same marble as the TAJ MAHAL!) - so it GLOWS in the sun! ✨

Built over 15 YEARS by thousands of workers and craftsmen! Every detail is PERFECT! 🏗️

The dome is topped with a BRONZE STATUE of Queen Victoria! Over 73 METERS TALL! 👑

Inside, there's a MUSEUM with 30+ galleries displaying PRICELESS ARTIFACTS! 🏛️

The surroundings are BEAUTIFUL - gardens with fountains, ponds, and landscaped walkways! 🌳

Over 2 MILLION visitors come EVERY YEAR to marvel at this MASTERPIECE! ✈️

At NIGHT, the illumination makes it look like a GLOWING PALACE from a FAIRY TALE! 👻

It's a UNESCO WORLD HERITAGE site - one of the finest examples of architectural FUSION! 🏆

en.title: 🪨 KALSI ASHOKA ROCK EDICT - Words Carved in Stone!
en.mainText: A giant rock with messages carved into it by Emperor Ashoka over 2,200 years ago!

keyFacts.text: Carved around 250 BCE by Emperor Ashoka! 📅

coolFacts.text: The writing is in ancient Brahmi script - one of the oldest writing systems in India!

didYouKnow.text: Emperor Ashoka carved messages on rocks and pillars all across ancient India to teach his people about kindness, instead of building statues of himself!

tryThis.text: See if you can spot the carved elephant above the inscription when you visit!

en.narration:
In the village of Kalsi sits an enormous rock with a very old message carved into it! 🪨

Over 2,200 years ago, Emperor Ashoka ordered these words to be carved in ancient Brahmi script, teaching his people to be kind and peaceful.

Above the message, there's even a carving of an elephant! This rock is one of only 14 major edicts of Ashoka ever found in India.

en.mainText: Haryana's official state animal is the Blackbuck - one of the fastest animals in India! Males turn jet-black as they grow older! 🏃

keyFacts.text: Official state animal of Haryana! 🏆
Also called the Indian antelope! 🦌
Top speed: up to 80 km/h! 🏎️
Males are dark brown-black on top, white underneath! ⚫
Females and young males are tan-colored! 🟤
Spiral horns can grow over 60 cm long (males only)! 🌀
Lives in open grasslands and farmland! 🌾
Found in protected areas like Bir Bhaduri Wildlife Sanctuary! 🛡️
Once endangered - now a conservation success story in Haryana! 💚
Weight: 25-45 kg! 💪

coolFacts.text: Blackbucks are among the fastest land animals in India! 🏃
They can leap almost 2 meters straight up while running! 🦘
Only males grow the long spiral horns! 🌀
A male's coat gets darker the older and stronger he gets! ⚫
Blackbucks are sacred in some local traditions and legends! 🙏

didYouKnow.text: Blackbucks can run up to 80 km/h - almost as fast as a car on the highway - and they can also jump nearly 2 meters into the air while sprinting! 🏎️

tryThis.text: Time yourself running as fast as you can for 10 seconds, then imagine a Blackbuck covering more than double that distance in the same time! 🏃

en.narration:
Haryana's state animal is built for speed! The Blackbuck can race across open grassland at up to 80 km/h - almost as fast as cars drive on the highway! 🏎️

Males turn a striking dark brown-black color as they get older and grow long, spiral horns that twist like a corkscrew - sometimes over half a meter long! 🌀

Blackbucks almost disappeared from India because of hunting, but protected areas in Haryana have helped their numbers bounce back. Watching a herd sprint across a field is one of nature's fastest shows! 🦌

keyFacts.text: One of the 12 Jyotirlingas - the holiest Shiva shrines in India! 🕉️

en.narration:
In the town of Deoghar - whose name means 'Abode of Gods' - stands the Baidyanath Temple. 🛕

It's one of the 12 Jyotirlingas, the holiest Shiva shrines in all of India, and it draws many visitors every year!

During the Shravani Mela festival, pilgrims walk over 100 kilometers carrying holy water just to offer it here - a journey of pure dedication!

en.narration:
On the shores of Odisha stands one of the most amazing temples in the world - the Konark Sun Temple! ☀️

It's shaped like a GIANT CHARIOT, with 24 huge stone wheels and 7 carved horses, built to honor the Sun God.

Here's the incredible part: each wheel is actually a working sundial! Ancient builders were so clever that you can still tell the time from the shadows the wheels cast today.

Every surface of the temple is covered in beautiful, detailed carvings - it's no wonder it's a UNESCO World Heritage Site!

en.title: 🍵 GUWAHATI - Gateway to the Northeast!

Assam produces roughly half of all the tea grown in India! ☕
Kamakhya Temple sits on a hill with a stunning view of the whole city! 🛕
The Brahmaputra is one of the few rivers in the world that is officially male in local tradition (most rivers in India are called goddesses)! 🌊

didYouKnow.text: People often mix up Assam tea and Darjeeling tea - but Darjeeling tea actually comes from West Bengal, in the Himalayan foothills! Assam tea is grown in the hot, humid Brahmaputra valley and has a completely different, bolder taste. ☕

tryThis.text: Next time you see a box of tea, check the label - does it say Assam or Darjeeling? Now you know where each one really comes from! 🔍

en.narration:
Guwahati is the gateway to India's whole Northeast! It sits right on the banks of the giant Brahmaputra River. 🌊

Assam is famous for its tea - Assam tea is strong, malty, and grown in the hot valley of the Brahmaputra. A LOT of people mix it up with Darjeeling tea, but that's actually from West Bengal, in cool mountain hills far away! Different plant, different taste! ☕

Not far from the city, at Kaziranga National Park, you can find the greatest concentration of one-horned rhinos anywhere on Earth! 🦏

Thick skin - armor! 🛡️

Powerful, strong!

Only 3,500 left! 😢

Critically ENDANGERED!

Assam - last refuge! 🌳

Conservation working! 📈

Numbers increasing! 🎉

We MUST protect them! 💚

as.title: 🦏 एक सींग वाला गैंडा!
as.mainText: एक सींग वाला गैंडा असम के प्रसिद्ध वन्य जीवों में से एक है और काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान इसके लिए जाना जाता है।

en.title: 🎉 AMAZING FUN FACTS - Assam Treasures!
en.mainText: Assam - TEA PARADISE! Brahmaputra, rhinos, culture, one-horned rhinos! 🍵

keyFacts.text: Assam tea - world-famous!
60% of India's tea!
Brahmaputra - world's LARGEST river!
Kaziranga - rhino capital!
One-horned rhinos - 2,000+!
Seven Sister States - NE!
Assamese silk - famous!
Skilled artisans weave bamboo into baskets, furniture, and mats! 🎋
Tribal culture - rich!
Biodiversity - amazing!

coolFacts.text: Assam tea leaves - quality!
One-horned rhino - unique!
Brahmaputra - 3,600 km!
Tea plantations - green!
Tribal wisdom - forest!
Silk production - ancient!
Bamboo crafts - traditional!
Tea gardens - employment!

didYouKnow.text: Assam produces 60% of INDIA'S TEA! It's TEA CAPITAL of world! One-horned rhinos - Kaziranga! Cultural POWERHOUSE! 🌟

tryThis.text: Visit tea gardens! See rhinos! Experience Assamese culture! 🍵

en.narration:
Assam is INCREDIBLE! 🍵

TEA CAPITAL - 60% production! ☕

Brahmaputra - MASSIVE river! 🌊

Kaziranga - rhino paradise! 🦏

One-horned rhinos - 2,000+!

Tribal culture - RICH! 🏹

Silk production! 🧵

Bamboo crafts! 🎨

Biodiversity - amazing! 🦅

Assam = TREASURE CHEST! 💚

en.title: 🛕 KAMAKHYA TEMPLE - A Sacred Hilltop Shrine!
en.mainText: One of the most important temples in India, sitting on top of Nilachal Hill in Guwahati!

keyFacts.text: Located on Nilachal Hill overlooking the Brahmaputra River! ⛰️
One of the oldest of the 51 Shakti Peethas in India! 🛕
Famous for the Ambubachi Mela festival held every June! 🎉

coolFacts.text: The temple's unique dome shape looks like a beehive, different from most other Indian temples!
Thousands of pilgrims from all over India travel here every year for the Ambubachi Mela festival!

didYouKnow.text: Kamakhya Temple sits high on a hill with a spectacular view of the mighty Brahmaputra River flowing below!

tryThis.text: If you visit, look up at the beehive-shaped dome - it's a completely different temple style!

en.narration:
High on Nilachal Hill, overlooking the mighty Brahmaputra River, sits the Kamakhya Temple! 🛕

It's one of the oldest and most important Shakti temples in all of India, with a history stretching back many centuries.

Unlike most temples, its dome is shaped like a beehive! Every June, thousands of pilgrims travel here for the Ambubachi Mela festival.

as.title: 🛕 কামাখ্যা মন্দিৰ!
as.mainText: এইটো নীলাচল পাহাৰৰ ওপৰত থকা এক পবিত্ৰ মন্দিৰ!
as.narration: ব্ৰহ্মপুত্ৰ নদীৰ ওপৰত থকা এই মন্দিৰ অতি প্ৰাচীন!

capital.title: ☁️ SHILLONG - Scotland of the East!
capital.mainText: A cool, misty hill town so green and rolling that the British nicknamed it 'Scotland of the East'! It's the capital of the wettest state in India!

keyFacts.text: Capital of Meghalaya - name means 'Abode of Clouds'! ☁️
Population: around 1.5 LAKH people in Shillong city! 🏙️
Nicknamed 'Scotland of the East' by the British! 🏴
Ward's Lake: pretty man-made lake right in the city! 🌊
Shillong Peak: highest point, great city views! 🏔️
Cool climate all year - rarely gets very hot! 🌤️
Home to a big music and rock band scene! 🎸
Khasi Hills surround the city! ⛰️
Elephant Falls: waterfall just outside town! 💧
Best time to visit: October-May! 🌦️

coolFacts.text: Shillong is sometimes called the 'Rock Capital of India' because of its huge live-music culture! 🎸
Meghalaya's name literally means 'Home of the Clouds' in Sanskrit! ☁️
The state has one of the highest literacy rates in the Northeast! 📚
Shillong's weather stays cool and pleasant almost year-round! 🌤️
It was once the capital of the whole undivided Assam region! 🏛️

didYouKnow.text: Meghalaya is one of only a few places in India where society is matrilineal - property and family names pass down through the mother's side, not the father's! 👩‍👧

tryThis.text: Ask your family whose last name you have - now imagine if it worked the opposite way, like it does for the Khasi people! 💭

capital.narration:
Shillong sits high in the hills of Meghalaya, wrapped in mist and cool breezes almost all year round! ☁️

The British loved it so much they called it the 'Scotland of the East' because the green rolling hills reminded them of home.

Today, Shillong is famous across India for something surprising - rock music! Bands from this small hill town have won national competitions, earning it the nickname 'Rock Capital of India'! 🎸

Just outside the city, waterfalls tumble down green hillsides, and the whole region gets some of the heaviest rain on the planet.

language.title: 🗣️ KHASI - Meghalaya's Musical Tongue!
language.mainText: Khasi is one of the few major Indian languages that isn't related to Hindi or most other Indian languages at all - it belongs to a totally different language family!

keyFacts.text: Main languages: Khasi, Garo, and Jaintia! 🗣️
Khasi belongs to the Austroasiatic language family - very different from Hindi! 🌏
Written using the Roman (English) alphabet, not a separate script! ✍️
KHUBLEI = Thank you in Khasi! 💚
PHI KUMNO = How are you? in Khasi! 🙏
Garo is spoken mainly in the western Garo Hills region! 🏔️
Passed down mostly through oral storytelling and song! 📖
Meghalaya society is matrilineal - names and property pass through mothers! 👩
Christian missionaries first wrote Khasi down using Roman letters in the 1840s! ⛪
English is also widely spoken, especially in schools! 🎓

coolFacts.text: Khasi is related to languages spoken in Southeast Asia, not to Hindi! 🌏
It's one of the few Indian languages written entirely in the Roman alphabet! ✍️
Family surnames in Khasi society come from the mother, not the father! 👩‍👧
Rich oral tradition - many Khasi stories were never written down for centuries! 📖
Garo has its own separate grammar and vocabulary from Khasi! 🗣️

didYouKnow.text: Most Indian languages like Hindi, Marathi and Bengali come from the same family tree - but Khasi doesn't! It's related instead to languages spoken far away in Southeast Asia, like Vietnamese and Khmer. 🌏

tryThis.text: Try saying 'Khublei' (thank you) - it's pronounced roughly 'koob-LAY'! 🎤

language.narration:
Khasi sounds nothing like Hindi, and that's because it comes from a totally different family of languages - one shared with places like Vietnam and Cambodia, far across Southeast Asia! 🌏

It's written using the same alphabet as English, which is unusual for an Indian language - missionaries wrote it down for the first time less than 200 years ago.

In Khasi and Garo communities, family names pass down through mothers, not fathers - so when you meet someone in Meghalaya, their surname tells you about their mother's family line! 👩‍👧

food.title: 🍲 JADOH - Meghalaya's Rice and Meat Treasure!
food.mainText: A hearty rice dish cooked together with meat and spices, often colored deep red - Jadoh is the Khasi comfort food eaten at every celebration!

keyFacts.text: Jadoh = rice cooked together with meat (often pork)! 🍚
Sometimes colored deep red using pig's blood - a traditional style! 🔴
Served at festivals, weddings, and family gatherings! 🎉
Tungrymbai: fermented soybean dish, a Khasi favorite! 🫘
Dohneiiong: pork cooked with black sesame paste! 🥘
Rice is the daily staple across Meghalaya! 🍚
Bamboo shoots often added for a tangy crunch! 🎋
Food is usually mild on outside spice but rich in flavor! 🌿
Smoked meats are common in the hills! 🔥
Local rice beer is part of many celebrations! 🍶

coolFacts.text: Jadoh gets its deep red color from a traditional pork-blood cooking method! 🔴
Almost every Khasi celebration includes a big pot of Jadoh! 🎉
Fermented soybean (Tungrymbai) is a beloved everyday flavor booster! 🫘
Bamboo shoots grow wild in the hills and flavor many dishes! 🎋
Smoking meat over wood fires is a common way to preserve food in the hills! 🔥

didYouKnow.text: Jadoh is cooked in huge pots for festivals, and the whole community often gathers to help cook and share it together! 🍲

tryThis.text: Ask an adult to help you cook rice with a favorite spice mix - notice how the color and smell change the whole dish, just like Jadoh! 🍳

food.narration:
Jadoh is Meghalaya's favorite comfort food - rice cooked right together with meat, so every grain soaks up the flavor! 🍲

At festivals, it's often colored a deep red using a traditional method, and everyone gathers around huge pots to share it.

Alongside it, you might find Tungrymbai, a tangy fermented soybean dish, or bamboo shoots picked fresh from the hillside forests - Meghalaya's food uses whatever the misty hills provide! 🎋

places.title: 🌉 LIVING ROOT BRIDGES - Bridges Grown, Not Built!
places.mainText: Deep in the rainforest, the Khasi people grow bridges out of living tree roots - some are over about a century old and still growing stronger every year!

keyFacts.text: Found near Cherrapunji and Mawlynnong villages! 📍
Made by training the roots of rubber fig trees across rivers! 🌳
Take 15-30 years to grow strong enough to cross! ⏳
Some bridges are over about a century old and still growing! 📅
The famous 'Double Decker' bridge has two levels stacked on top! 🌉
Grow stronger with age, unlike wooden bridges that rot! 💪
Cherrapunji/Mawsynram nearby are among the wettest places on Earth! 🌧️
A UNESCO Tentative World Heritage candidate! 🏅
Reaching some bridges takes a multi-hour trek through jungle! 🥾
Mawlynnong village nearby is called the 'cleanest village in Asia'! 🧹

coolFacts.text: Living root bridges get STRONGER over time instead of weaker! 💪
It can take a whole generation - 15 to 30 years - to grow just one bridge! ⏳
The Double Decker Root Bridge has two separate crossing levels! 🌉
They survive floods that would wash away wooden or concrete bridges! 🌊
Villagers guide the growing roots using bamboo scaffolding as a frame! 🎋

didYouKnow.text: Unlike normal bridges that wear out, living root bridges actually get stronger the older they get, because the tree roots keep growing and thickening! Some are more than a century old and still in daily use! 🌳

tryThis.text: Picture planting a tree today and not being able to walk across your 'bridge' until you're a grown-up with kids of your own - that's real patience! 🌱

places.narration:
In the rainy hills of Meghalaya, the Khasi people don't just build bridges - they GROW them! 🌳

They carefully guide the roots of rubber fig trees across rivers using bamboo frames. It takes 15 to 30 years for a root bridge to become strong enough to walk across - so a person might start one that their grandchildren finish using!

Some living root bridges are over about a century old, and instead of rotting away like wood, they just keep getting thicker and stronger every year. The famous Double Decker Bridge even has two crossing levels stacked on top of each other! 🌉

animal.title: 🐆 CLOUDED LEOPARD - The Ghost of the Forest!
animal.mainText: One of the most mysterious wild cats on Earth! The clouded leopard has the longest canine teeth relative to its size of any living cat, and it's a master tree climber!

keyFacts.text: Found in Meghalaya's forests and across Northeast India! 🌳
Weight: around 11-23 kg - medium-sized wild cat! ⚖️
Named for the cloud-shaped markings on its fur! ☁️
Can climb down trees head-first - rare among cats! 🌲
Has the longest canine teeth of any cat, relative to body size! 🦷
Extremely shy - rarely seen even by researchers! 👻
Mostly active at night (nocturnal)! 🌙
Its tail is almost as long as its whole body, for balance! 🐈
Listed as Vulnerable - threatened by habitat loss! 😢
Sometimes nicknamed the 'ghost of the forest'! 👻

coolFacts.text: It's one of the very few cats that can climb head-first down a tree trunk! 🌲
Its canine teeth are proportionally the longest of any cat alive - even bigger than a tiger's, relative to size! 🦷
It's so elusive that scientists still don't know a lot about its habits in the wild! 👻
Its long tail works like a tightrope walker's pole for balance! 🐈
Sometimes called a 'bridge' between big cats and small cats in evolution! 🌉

didYouKnow.text: The clouded leopard's canine teeth are proportionally the longest of any cat species alive today - even longer, compared to its skull size, than a tiger's! Scientists still aren't sure exactly why. 🦷

tryThis.text: Try climbing down a slide or ladder head-first (safely, with an adult around) - now imagine doing that down a tree trunk, like this cat does every day! 🌲

animal.narration:
Deep in Meghalaya's misty forests lives one of the world's most mysterious wild cats - the clouded leopard. 🐆

It's named for the cloud-shaped patches on its fur, and it has a superpower most cats don't: it can climb DOWN a tree trunk head-first, gripping with flexible ankles that rotate almost backward!

It's so shy and well-camouflaged that even scientists who study it rarely spot one in the wild - which is exactly why people call it the 'ghost of the forest'. 👻

funFact.title: 🌧️ MEGHALAYA - The Wettest Place on Earth!
funFact.mainText: Mawsynram, a tiny village in Meghalaya, receives more rainfall than almost anywhere else on the planet - over 11,000mm a year!

keyFacts.text: Mawsynram: officially the wettest place on Earth! 🌧️
Receives over 11,000mm (11 meters!) of rain some years! ☔
Nearby Cherrapunji also competes for the title! 🌦️
Rain comes mostly from monsoon clouds trapped by the hills! ⛰️
Living root bridges grow BECAUSE of all this rain! 🌉
Meghalaya society is matrilineal - very rare worldwide! 👩‍👧
State's name means 'Abode of Clouds' in Sanskrit! ☁️
Home to some of Asia's longest and deepest caves! 🕳️
Shillong is nicknamed the 'Rock Capital of India' for its music scene! 🎸
Borders Bangladesh to the south! 🗺️

coolFacts.text: Mawsynram gets so much rain that people there weave special bamboo-and-leaf raincoats called 'knups'! ☔
The hills of Meghalaya trap monsoon clouds, squeezing out enormous amounts of rain! ⛰️
Meghalaya has some of the longest cave systems in all of Asia! 🕳️
The matrilineal Khasi and Garo tribes are among the few such societies left in the world! 👩
All that rain is exactly why living root bridges are needed - regular bridges would wash away! 🌉

didYouKnow.text: In Mawsynram, it can rain SO much that people traditionally wear a bamboo-and-banana-leaf shield called a 'knup' over their whole body, like a portable roof, while working outside in the rain! ☔

tryThis.text: Look up how much rain your city gets in a whole year, then compare it to Mawsynram's 11,000+ mm - it might be 10 times more! 🌧️

funFact.narration:
Meghalaya's name means 'Abode of Clouds' - and it earns that name every single day! ☁️

The tiny village of Mawsynram holds the record for the most rainfall on Earth, with monsoon clouds slamming into the hills and dumping over 11 meters of rain in a single year!

All that water is exactly why the Khasi people grow living root bridges instead of building wooden ones - and why the region is covered in deep caves, waterfalls, and some of the greenest forests in India. 🌧️

monument.title: 🗿 NARTIANG MONOLITHS - A Forest Full of Ancient Stones!
monument.mainText: A mysterious park filled with GIANT standing stones, some over 1,000 years old!

keyFacts.text: Home to the tallest monolith in Meghalaya - over 8 meters tall! 📏
Erected by the Jaintia kings to honor ancestors and mark events! 👑
Located in Nartiang village in the Jaintia Hills! 📍

coolFacts.text: Nobody knows exactly how ancient people moved and stood up such GIANT stones without machines!
Each stone was placed to remember a person, a victory, or an important event - like ancient memorials!

didYouKnow.text: The tallest monolith at Nartiang stands over 8 meters tall - about as tall as a two-story building - and was placed there without any modern machines!

tryThis.text: Count how many different-sized stones you can find standing in the park!

monument.narration:
In the Jaintia Hills of Meghalaya stands a forest full of GIANT ancient stones! 🗿

These monoliths were placed by Jaintia kings hundreds of years ago to honor ancestors and remember important events - like nature's own memorial park.

The tallest stone here reaches over 8 meters high! Nobody is quite sure how ancient people moved such massive stones without today's machines.

en.title: 🏰 AGARTALA - City of the Royal Palace!
en.mainText: Home to Ujjayanta Palace, once the royal home of Tripura's kings and now a beautiful museum right in the middle of the city!

keyFacts.text: Capital of Tripura, on the Haora River! 🌊
Population: around 4 LAKH people in Agartala city! 🏙️
Ujjayanta Palace: built in 1901, former royal residence! 🏰
Palace is now a state museum with royal artifacts! 🖼️
Surrounded by Bangladesh on almost every side! 🗺️
Tripura Sundari Temple nearby - important pilgrimage site! 🛕
Bamboo and cane handicrafts are a local specialty! 🎋
Rubber plantations are a major local industry! 🌳
Once the capital of an independent kingdom for centuries! 👑
Best time to visit: October-March! 🌤️

coolFacts.text: Ujjayanta Palace has beautifully landscaped gardens with reflecting pools! 🏞️
Tripura was ruled by its own kings for centuries before joining India in 1949! 👑
The palace blends European, Mughal, and local architectural styles! 🏛️
Tripura is almost completely surrounded by another country - Bangladesh! 🗺️
Rubber is one of Tripura's biggest crops, alongside rice! 🌳

didYouKnow.text: Tripura was its own independent kingdom, ruled by the Manikya dynasty, for over 500 years before it joined India in 1949! ⏳

tryThis.text: Find Tripura on a map of India - notice how it's almost completely surrounded by Bangladesh! 🗺️

en.narration:
Agartala grew up around a royal palace - Ujjayanta Palace, built by Tripura's king in 1901, with grand halls and gardens full of reflecting pools. 🏰

Tripura was its very own kingdom for hundreds of years, ruled by the Manikya dynasty, before joining India in 1949.

Today the old palace is a museum where you can see royal treasures, and the city sits almost entirely surrounded by the country of Bangladesh - only a thin strip connects it to the rest of India! 🗺️

en.title: 🗣️ KOKBOROK - The Voice of the Tripuri People!
en.mainText: Kokborok is the native language of the Tripuri people - the name itself means 'the language of humans'!

keyFacts.text: KOKBOROK = 'KOK' (language/word) + 'BOROK' (human/people)! 💬
Native language of the Tripuri tribal community! 🏘️
Bengali is also widely spoken across Tripura! 🗣️
Kokborok is written in the Bengali script today! ✍️
KHULUMKHA = Hello in Kokborok! 🙏
BURUI = Thank you in Kokborok! 💚
Belongs to the Tibeto-Burman language family! 🌏
Recognized as an official language of Tripura! 🏛️
Kept alive through folk songs and oral storytelling! 🎵
Related to languages spoken in Northeast India and Myanmar! 🗺️

coolFacts.text: Kokborok comes from a totally different language family than Bengali or Hindi! 🌏
The name literally translates to 'human language'! 💬
It's related to languages spoken across the border in Myanmar! 🗺️
Kokborok folk songs are an important way the language survives today! 🎵
Tripura recognizes both Bengali and Kokborok as official languages! 🏛️

didYouKnow.text: Kokborok belongs to the Tibeto-Burman language family, which connects it more closely to languages spoken in Myanmar and parts of China than to Hindi or Bengali! 🌏

tryThis.text: Try saying 'Khulumkha' (hello) out loud - it's a great new greeting to add to your collection! 👋

en.narration:
Kokborok's name says it all - 'Kok' means language, and 'Borok' means human, so Kokborok simply means 'the language of humans'. 💬

It's the native tongue of the Tripuri people, and it belongs to a completely different family of languages than Hindi or Bengali - one shared with parts of Myanmar and the wider Northeast.

Today, Kokborok is written using Bengali letters and is one of Tripura's two official languages, alongside Bengali itself. 🗣️

en.title: 🎋 MUI BOREK - Tripura's Bamboo Shoot Treasure!
en.mainText: A tangy, fermented bamboo shoot dish that gives Tripuri food its unique, unmistakable flavor - found in almost nothing else in India!

keyFacts.text: Mui Borok cuisine uses fermented bamboo shoots (Mosdeng)! 🎋
Bamboo shoots give dishes a sour, tangy kick! 🍋
Often cooked with fish, pork, or chicken! 🐟
Rice is the everyday staple across Tripura! 🍚
Berma: a fermented fish paste used for flavor! 🐠
Chakhwi: a mixed vegetable stew, a Tripuri classic! 🥘
Minimal oil and spice - focus on natural fermented flavors! 🌿
Recipes passed down through generations! 👨‍🍳
Bamboo grows everywhere in Tripura's forests! 🎋
Food reflects strong tribal and Bengali influences! 🍛

coolFacts.text: Fermenting bamboo shoots can take several days to weeks before they're ready to cook! ⏳
Tripuri food relies on fermentation instead of heavy spices for flavor! 🌿
Bamboo forests cover a huge part of Tripura's landscape! 🎋
Berma (fermented fish paste) is a beloved flavoring, similar to dishes across Northeast India! 🐠
Many Mui Borok dishes are naturally low in oil! 💧

didYouKnow.text: Fermented bamboo shoot dishes like this exist across much of Northeast India and neighboring Southeast Asia, showing how connected Tripura's food culture is to its geographic neighbors! 🎋

tryThis.text: Ask a grown-up if you can try pickled or fermented vegetables at home, and compare the tangy taste to regular cooked veggies! 🥒

en.narration:
Tripuri food gets its unique tang from something most Indian kitchens don't use much - fermented bamboo shoots! 🎋

Called Mosdeng, these bamboo shoots are left to ferment for days before being cooked into dishes with fish, chicken, or pork, giving Mui Borok cuisine its sour, unmistakable flavor.

Instead of piling on spices, Tripuri cooking leans on fermentation for flavor - a style shared with neighbors across the hills of Northeast India and beyond. 🌿

en.title: 🏰 UJJAYANTA PALACE - Where Kings Once Lived!
en.mainText: A grand royal palace with domes, gardens, and reflecting pools - built by Tripura's king over a century ago and now open for everyone to visit!

keyFacts.text: Built in 1901 by Maharaja Radha Kishore Manikya! 👑
Was the royal residence of Tripura's kings! 🏰
Now a state museum, open to the public! 🖼️
Features grand domes and Mughal-style gardens! 🕌
Surrounded by lakes and reflecting pools! 🏞️
Houses artifacts from Tripura's royal history! 💎
Blends European, Mughal, and local design styles! 🏛️
Lit up beautifully at night! ✨
Located right in the heart of Agartala! 📍
A top tourist attraction in Northeast India! 🌟

coolFacts.text: The palace grounds include manicured gardens modeled after Mughal garden design! 🌳
It took years to build and shows off three different architectural styles at once! 🏛️
Royal families of Tripura lived here until the kingdom joined India! 👑
The palace glows beautifully when lit up at night! ✨
Museum displays include old royal weapons, clothing, and artwork! 🗡️

didYouKnow.text: Ujjayanta Palace mixes three different architectural styles - European, Mughal, and traditional local design - all in one building, which is unusual for a palace of its time! 🏛️

tryThis.text: Design your own imaginary palace by picking your favorite parts from three different building styles you know! 🎨

en.narration:
Right in the middle of Agartala stands Ujjayanta Palace, built in 1901 for Tripura's royal family. 🏰

Its grand domes, sprawling gardens, and calm reflecting pools once belonged only to kings and their court. Today, anyone can walk through its halls, which are now a museum full of royal treasures, old weapons, and artwork.

At night, the whole palace lights up, making it one of the famous sights in all of Northeast India. ✨

bn.title: 🏰 উজ্জয়ন্ত প্রাসাদ - রাজাদের পুরনো বাসভবন!
bn.mainText: উজ্জয়ন্ত প্রাসাদ ত্রিপুরার রাজপরিবারের সঙ্গে যুক্ত একটি ঐতিহাসিক প্রাসাদ, যার গম্বুজ, বাগান ও জলাশয় খুবই আকর্ষণীয়।
bn.narration: আগরতলার উজ্জয়ন্ত প্রাসাদ একসময় ত্রিপুরার রাজপরিবারের বাসভবন ছিল। বর্তমানে এটি রাজ্যের ইতিহাস ও সংস্কৃতির সঙ্গে পরিচিত হওয়ার একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ স্থান। 🏰

en.title: 🐒 PHAYRE'S LANGUR - Tripura's Spectacled Monkey!
en.mainText: Tripura's official state animal is a leaf-eating monkey with white rings around its eyes that look just like glasses!

keyFacts.text: Official state animal of Tripura! 🏆
Also called the spectacled langur, for its eye markings! 👓
Fur is gray, with a lighter belly! ⚪
Lives in groups high in the forest canopy! 🌳
Eats mostly leaves, fruit, and flowers! 🍃
Babies are born bright orange, then turn gray! 🧡
Found in forests of Tripura and Northeast India! 🌏
Listed as an Endangered species! 😢
Rarely comes down to the ground! 🌲
Communicates with loud calls across the forest! 📢

coolFacts.text: Baby Phayre's langurs are born bright orange and slowly turn gray as they grow! 🧡
The white rings around its eyes make it look like it's wearing spectacles! 👓
It almost never leaves the treetops its whole life! 🌳
Groups can include a dozen or more monkeys living together! 👥
It's found in only a few pockets of forest left in the region! 😢

didYouKnow.text: Baby Phayre's langurs are born a bright orange color - completely different from the gray adults - and scientists think this helps other monkeys in the group easily spot and protect the babies! 🧡

tryThis.text: Draw a monkey wearing glasses - that's basically what a Phayre's langur looks like in real life! 🖍️

en.narration:
Tripura's state animal wears its own natural spectacles! The Phayre's langur has bright white rings circling its eyes, making it look like it's peering through a pair of glasses. 👓

These leaf-eating monkeys live in groups high up in the forest canopy and almost never touch the ground. And here's something surprising - their babies are born bright orange, not gray, slowly changing color as they grow older! 🧡

Sadly, this gentle monkey is now endangered, surviving in only a few patches of Tripura's shrinking forests.

bn.title: 🐒 फेयर का पत्ती बंदर!
bn.mainText: फेयर का पत्ती बंदर त्रिपुरा के वन्य जीवों में पाया जाता है और उत्तर-पूर्व भारत के जंगलों में भी मिलता है।

en.title: 🌏 TRIPURA - Tiny State, Big Heart!
